  <body>
<img id="lq-v47-npc-atlas" alt="" aria-hidden="true" width="290" height="210" style="position:fixed;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0" src="data:image/png;base64,">
    <!-- React Root handles the overlay UI, cheatsheet guide, status indicators, and mounting -->
    <div id="root"></div>

    <!-- 2D Canvas Container -->
    <div id="game"></div>

    <button id="v10-open" type="button" style="position:fixed;right:148px;top:13px;z-index:9001" title="Smart economy (B)">💰 Economy (B)</button>
    <!-- NPC Chat Overlay -->
    <div id="chat" role="dialog" aria-label="NPC conversation">
      <button type="button" id="chat-close" title="Leave conversation (Esc)" aria-label="Leave conversation">×</button>
      <aside class="lq772-sidebar">
        <div class="lq771-header">
          <div class="lq772-stage"><canvas class="lq772-landscape" id="lq772-landscape" width="160" height="112" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><div class="lq771-portrait" data-mood="neutral"><canvas id="lq771-avatar" width="192" height="192" role="img"></canvas><span id="lq771-initial" aria-hidden="true">?</span></div><div class="lq772-scene-tag" id="lq772-area">LifeQuest World</div><div class="lq772-day" id="lq772-day">DAY 1</div><div class="lq772-status">Locating scene…</div><div class="lq773-emblem" id="lq773-emblem" aria-hidden="true">—</div></div>
          <div class="lq771-identity"><div class="lq771-eyebrow">CHARACTER PROFILE <span>V80</span></div><div class="name"></div><div class="lq772-activity" id="lq772-activity"></div><div id="lq774-credit" class="lq774-credit"></div><div class="lq773-emotion"><span class="lq773-eyebrow">Current NPC expression</span><div id="lq771-mood" aria-live="polite">Not assessed</div><div id="lq773-emotion-source">Awaiting reply</div><div id="lq773-emotion-detail"></div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="lq772-rel"><div class="lq772-relrow"><span>Relationship</span><strong id="lq772-affinity">Stranger</strong></div><div class="lq772-track"><span id="lq772-fill"></span></div><div class="lq773-relscale"><span>−20</span><span>0</span><span>100</span></div></div><div class="lq773-facts"><span id="lq773-room" hidden></span><span id="lq773-visits" hidden></span></div>
        <div class="lq771-mission" data-done="false"><div class="lq772-missionlabel">◇ Current objective</div><div class="goal"></div><div id="lq773-reward" class="lq773-reward"></div><button type="button" id="v10-npc-shop" hidden>🛒 Shop (B)</button></div>
      </aside>
      <section class="lq772-main"><div class="lq772-titlebar"><div><div class="lq772-kicker">LifeQuest / Beyond the Living World</div><div class="lq772-title">Conversation</div></div><span class="lq772-level" id="lq772-level">CEFR</span></div>
      <div class="lq771-loghead"><span>Messages</span><span id="lq773-provider" class="lq773-provider"></span><span id="lq781-turn" role="status" aria-live="polite">Ready</span><button id="lq79-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="lq79-tools">Context &amp; practice</button><button id="lq771-reveal" type="button" title="Show the entire current message">Reveal text ›</button></div>
      <div class="log" aria-label="Conversation messages" tabindex="0"></div>
      <div class="npc-coach"><button id="npc-suggest" type="button" title="Suggest 3 English sentences that fit the conversation">✦ Reply ideas</button><div id="npc-suggestions" aria-label="English reply suggestions"></div></div>
      <div class="inrow"><input type="text" placeholder="Speak your mind in English…" autocomplete="off" /><button id="mic" type="button" title="Speak English (Alt+M)" aria-label="Speak English">🎤</button><button id="lq771-send" type="button" title="Send message (Enter)">Send ›</button></div>
      <div class="hint"><span class="lq771-keys">Enter · Send / Esc · Close / Alt+M · Mic / ?word · Dictionary</span><button type="button" id="lq78-motion" title="Toggle portrait motion" aria-pressed="true" onclick="this.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(LQ78Motion.toggle()));this.textContent='Motion: '+(LQ78Motion.enabled()?'ON':'OFF')">Motion: ON</button><button id="teacher" type="button" title="AI teacher fixes your grammar under each message">✎ Teacher: ON</button><button id="voice-toggle" type="button" title="Toggle NPC voice">🔊 Voice: ON</button></div></section>
      <aside id="lq79-tools" class="lq79-drawer" aria-label="Conversation tools" hidden><header><span>Context &amp; practice</span><button type="button" id="lq79-close" aria-label="Close tools">Close ×</button></header><nav aria-label="Tool categories"><button type="button" data-lq79-tab="scene" aria-pressed="true">Scene</button><button type="button" data-lq79-tab="memory" aria-pressed="false">Memory</button><button type="button" data-lq79-tab="coach" aria-pressed="false">Coach</button><button type="button" data-lq79-tab="paths" aria-pressed="false">Topics</button><button type="button" data-lq79-tab="group" aria-pressed="false">Nearby chat</button></nav><div id="lq79-content" aria-live="polite"></div></aside>
    </div>

    <!-- Quest Briefing Overlay -->
    <div id="briefing">
      <div class="name"></div>
      <div class="text"></div>
      <div class="row">
        <span class="hint">E / Space / Enter: continue &nbsp;|&nbsp; Esc: stay here</span>
        <span><span class="step"></span><button class="next" type="button">Next ▸</button></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Word Helper (Vietnamese English Explanations) -->
    <div id="helper">
      <h3>📖 Word helper - ask about any hard word</h3>
      <div class="row">
        <input type="text" placeholder="Type a word, a phrase or a sentence (you can also ask in Vietnamese)" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" />
        <button id="helper-ask" type="button">Explain</button>
        <button id="helper-close" type="button">Close</button>
      </div>
      <div class="hout">
        <div class="wnote">Example: <b>polite</b>, <b>take care of</b>, or "How much does it cost?"</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hbook"></div>
      <div class="wnote">In a chat, type <b>?word</b> to ask without leaving the conversation. H: close</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Player Journal -->
    <div id="journal"></div>

    <!-- Quests Log -->
    <div id="quests"></div>

    <!-- Notification Toast -->
    <div id="toast"></div>

    <!-- Quick Group Menu Button & Menu -->
    <button id="group-btn" type="button" title="Open the menu (G)">☰ Menu (G)</button>
    <div id="group-menu">
      <button type="button" data-act="talk"><span>💬 Talk / sleep</span><kbd>E</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="quests"><span>📜 Quests</span><kbd>Q</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="journal"><span>📓 Journal</span><kbd>J</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="helper"><span>📖 Word helper</span><kbd>H</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="settings"><span>⚙ AI settings</span><kbd>K</kbd></button>
      <div class="sep"></div>
      <button type="button" data-act="reset"><span>🗑 Erase all progress</span><kbd>F8</kbd></button>
      <div class="tip">Move: WASD / arrows. At a door press W to enter. G: open or close this menu.</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Technical inputs are retained for backwards compatibility with the existing AI engine;
         no Gemini setup controls are displayed in the player interface. -->
    <div id="settings">
      <h3>⚙️ Storage &amp; data</h3>
      <p style="font-size:13px;color:#bcd0e4">Export or import your game progress. Existing AI settings are kept; no API key is required to enter the game.</p>
      <div hidden aria-hidden="true">
        <input id="ai-key" type="password" autocomplete="off" />
        <input id="ai-model" type="text" autocomplete="off" />
        <button id="ai-save" type="button">Save</button><button id="ai-test" type="button">Test</button><button id="ai-clear" type="button">Clear</button>
      </div>
      <div class="row"><button id="ai-close" type="button">Close</button></div>
      <div class="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <h3>💾 Progress backup</h3>
      <div class="row"><button id="save-export">Export save</button><button id="save-import">Import save</button><input id="save-file" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" style="display:none" /></div>
      <p class="note">Data is never deleted or reset automatically on upgrades.</p>
    </div>

    
<div id="lq-loading" hidden role="alert"><strong>Could not load the game</strong><p>Check your Internet connection and reload the page.</p></div>
<div id="lq-toolbar">
  <div class="lq-brand"><span class="lq-logo">LQ</span><div><div class="lq-title">LIFEQUEST AI · English Town</div><div id="ai-online-status">Starting…</div></div></div>
  <button id="level-open" type="button" title="English level">🎓 <span id="level-current">B1</span></button>
  <button id="voice-open" type="button" title="NPC voice">🔊 <span class="desktop-extra">Voice</span></button>
  <button type="button" class="desktop-extra" data-menu-shortcut="quests">📜 Quests</button>
  <button type="button" class="desktop-extra" data-menu-shortcut="helper">📖 Vocabulary</button>
  <button type="button" class="desktop-extra" data-menu-shortcut="settings">⚙️ AI</button>
  <button id="guide-open" type="button">❔ <span class="desktop-extra">Guide</span></button>
</div>
<button id="ai-open" type="button">🤖 AI Coach PRO · Chat + Control</button>
<section id="ai-panel" hidden aria-label="AI companion">
  <header><strong>🤖 AI Coach PRO <small>· smart learning &amp; control</small></strong><button id="copilot-close" type="button" aria-label="Close">×</button></header>
  <div id="ai-mode-tabs" role="group" aria-label="AI mode">
    <button class="selected" type="button" data-ai-mode="auto">✨ Auto</button><button type="button" data-ai-mode="chat">💬 Chat</button><button type="button" data-ai-mode="learn">📖 Learn</button><button type="button" data-ai-mode="control">🎮 Control</button>
  </div>
  <div id="study-stats" aria-live="polite" title="Practice stats are saved in this browser">📊 Loading learning progress…</div>
  <div id="ai-log" aria-live="polite"></div><p id="ai-busy" hidden>✨ Thinking… <button type="button" id="ai-cancel">Cancel</button></p>
  <div id="ai-suggestions"><button type="button" data-ai-example="Đến Lily và nói chuyện">👋 Meet Lily</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="Lily là ai?">❔ Ask an NPC</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="quiz">🧠 Quiz</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="Sửa câu: I goes to school">✍️ Fix sentence</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="Từ vựng: library">📚 Vocabulary</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="Luyện hội thoại">🎭 Roleplay</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="Tôi đang ở đâu?">📍 Location</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="flashcard">🃏 Flashcard</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="thử thách hôm nay">🏆 Today</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="thống kê">📊 Progress</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="kịch bản: quán cà phê">🎬 Scenario</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="lộ trình học">🎯 Study plan</button><button type="button" data-ai-example="sổ từ vựng">📒 Word book</button></div>
  <form id="ai-form"><input id="ai-input" type="text" maxlength="1800" placeholder="Type a question, an English sentence or a command…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Enter a question or command for the AI"/><button id="ai-mic" type="button" title="Speak instead of typing">🎤</button><button id="ai-send" type="submit">➤</button></form>
  <footer><span id="ai-mode-note">The AI tries to answer what you really mean</span><div class="ai-tools"><button id="ai-read" type="button" title="Read the latest answer aloud">🔊</button><button id="ai-copy" type="button" title="Copy the answer">📋</button><button id="ai-save-chat" type="button" title="Export chat history">💾</button><button id="ai-export-words" type="button" title="Export word book">📒</button><button id="ai-clear-chat" type="button" title="Clear chat history">🗑️</button><button id="ai-stop" type="button">■ Stop</button></div></footer>
</section>

<button id="rpg-open" type="button" title="Open RPG: level, story, inventory, NPCs (R)">🎒 RPG <span class="desktop-extra">· Story</span></button>
<div id="rpg-hud" aria-live="polite">⭐ Level 1 · $100</div>
<div id="rpg-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div id="rpg-panel" hidden aria-label="LIFEQUEST RPG quests and inventory">
  <div class="rpg-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="rpg-title">
    <header class="rpg-header"><div><b>🏰 LIFEQUEST RPG · V5</b><div id="rpg-title">Loading progress…</div></div><button id="rpg-close" type="button" aria-label="Close the RPG panel">×</button></header>
    <nav id="rpg-tabs" aria-label="RPG sections"></nav>
    <div id="rpg-content"></div>
    <footer>WASD / arrow keys: move · E: talk · R: open or close the RPG panel · Data is saved automatically in your browser</footer>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="lq-modal" id="lq-guide" hidden><div class="lq-dialog"><h2>🗺️ English Town guide</h2><p>Move with <b>WASD</b> or the <b>arrow keys</b>. Press <b>E</b> next to an NPC to chat in English; press <b>W / ↑</b> to enter a building door. Inside, press <b>E</b> near the stairs to change floors or near objects to explore. Press <b>G</b> to open the menu, <b>Q</b> for quests, <b>H</b> for the word helper, <b>K</b> for Gemini settings.</p><p>🤖 Press the <b>AI companion</b> button and give a command such as “đến Lily và nói chuyện” (go to Lily and talk), “đến bệnh viện” (go to the hospital), “đi sang phải 2 giây” (walk right for 2 seconds) or “dừng” (stop). The character walks by itself if a path is found.</p><p>💬 In an NPC dialogue, press <b>✨ AI sentence suggestions</b> to get three fitting English sentences. The AI assistant recognises whether you want to chat, learn or control the game, and offers flashcards, a word book and quiz stats; try “Lily là ai?” (who is Lily?), “sửa câu: I goes to school” (fix a sentence), “quiz”, “từ vựng: library” (vocabulary) or “luyện hội thoại” (conversation practice).</p><p>New here? Replay the opening scene and the step-by-step tutorial from Menu → Settings → 🎬 Intro &amp; tutorial. The game also runs without Internet (the NPCs then use their offline replies). Online Gemini AI needs an API key in section K; never write the key into the source code when publishing a public website.</p><div class="lq-actions"><button id="guide-close" type="button">Got it</button></div></div></div>
<div class="lq-modal" id="lq-levels" hidden><div class="lq-dialog"><h2>🎓 English level</h2><p>Choose the difficulty for NPC conversations (CEFR):</p><label>Level <select id="level-select"><option value="A1">A1 · Beginner</option><option value="A2">A2 · Elementary</option><option value="B1">B1 · Intermediate</option><option value="B2">B2 · Upper-intermediate</option><option value="C1">C1 · Advanced</option></select></label><div class="lq-actions"><button id="level-close" type="button">Done</button></div></div></div>
<div class="lq-modal" id="lq-voice" hidden><div class="lq-dialog"><h2>🔊 English voice</h2><label><input id="voice-enabled" type="checkbox"> Read NPC lines aloud</label><label><input id="voice-auto" type="checkbox"> Auto-read after each NPC line</label><label>Voice: <select id="voice-list"></select></label><label>Speed: <span id="voice-rate-value">0.9</span>× <input id="voice-rate" type="range" min="0.6" max="1.4" step="0.1" value="0.9"></label><div class="lq-actions"><button id="voice-test" type="button">▶ Test voice</button><button id="voice-close" type="button">Done</button></div></div></div>

<!-- LIFEQUEST AI CONFIG: edit only in a PRIVATE, locally stored copy of this HTML.
     NEVER publish a real Gemini key in a public HTML file, GitHub, or Netlify site.
     When hosting on Netlify, use GEMINI_API_KEY as an environment variable instead. -->
<script>
window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG = {
  GEMINI_API_KEY: '', // <-- PASTE YOUR OWN KEY HERE ONLY FOR A PRIVATE LOCAL HTML FILE
  MODEL: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
  PROXY_URL: '/api/gemini', // V77 ships a secure relay (v77/backend/server.cjs or the Netlify function). Without a key the game probes it and falls back to offline rules, clearly labelled.
  // Accounts + cloud saves (see SUPABASE_SETUP.md). Leave empty to play without accounts.
  // The anon key is meant to be public; never put the service_role key here.
  SUPABASE_URL: 'https://delrfngvivicxkvedxlc.supabase.co',
  SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: 'sb_publishable_Y7lw3R4kVMV-eAa0D4mR-A_b4S2hMS8'
};

</script>
<script>
/* Auto-repair: nếu model đã lưu/mặc định không còn tồn tại (404), tự chọn model Gemini Flash ổn định mới nhất cho key này và lưu lại. */
(function(){
  const KEY='english-town-ai';
  const read=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch{return {}}};
  async function repair(){
    try{
      const saved=read();
      const key=String(saved.geminiKey||window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.GEMINI_API_KEY||'').trim();
      if(!key)return;
      const model=String(saved.geminiModel||window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.MODEL||'gemini-2.5-flash').trim();
      const H={'x-goog-api-key':key};
      const chk=await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/'+encodeURIComponent(model),{headers:H});
      if(chk.status!==404)return;
      const r=await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=200',{headers:H});
      if(!r.ok)return;
      const list=((await r.json()).models||[]).filter(m=>(m.supportedGenerationMethods||[]).includes('generateContent'))
        .map(m=>m.name.replace(/^models\//,'')).filter(n=>/^gemini-[\d.]+-flash(-lite)?$/.test(n));
      const ver=n=>(n.match(/gemini-([\d.]+)/)[1]).split('.').map(Number);
      const cmp=(a,b)=>{const x=ver(a),y=ver(b);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const d=(y[i]||0)-(x[i]||0);if(d)return d;}return 0;};
      list.sort((a,b)=>(/lite/.test(a)-/lite/.test(b))||cmp(a,b));
      if(!list.length)return;
      saved.geminiModel=list[0];
      localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(saved));
      console.info('[LIFEQUEST] Model "'+model+'" no longer exists (404) -> using "'+list[0]+'"');
    }catch(e){console.warn('[LIFEQUEST] model repair skipped',e)}
  }
  window.__lqModelReady=repair();
})();

</script>

<script>
/*
 * Dandelion artwork, drawn with code (no image file needed).
 *  - LQDandelion.icon(size)  -> small SVG logo (string)
 *  - LQDandelion.mount(canvas) -> draws the big dandelion at dusk with seeds drifting in the wind;
 *                                 returns a function that stops the animation.
 */
(function () {
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

  function icon(size) {
    const n = 26,
      parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * TAU,
        r = i % 2 ? 11 : 13.5;
      const x1 = 24 + Math.cos(a) * 3,
        y1 = 21 + Math.sin(a) * 3,
        x2 = 24 + Math.cos(a) * r,
        y2 = 21 + Math.sin(a) * r;
      parts.push(
        `<line x1="${x1.toFixed(2)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(2)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(2)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(2)}"/>` +
          `<circle cx="${x2.toFixed(2)}" cy="${y2.toFixed(2)}" r="1.3" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>`,
      );
    }
    return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">${parts.join('')}<circle cx="24" cy="21" r="2.4" fill="#ffd36b" stroke="none"/><path d="M24 24c0 8-2 14-4 20" stroke="#7bd49a" stroke-width="1.8"/></svg>`;
  }

  function mount(cv) {
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, bg = null, puff = null, geo = null, seeds = [], raf = 0, last = 0, stopped = false;

    const offscreen = (w, h) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = Math.ceil(w * dpr);
      c.height = Math.ceil(h * dpr);
      const x = c.getContext('2d');
      x.scale(dpr, dpr);
      return [c, x];
    };

    function makeBg() {
      const [c, x] = offscreen(W, H);
      const g = x.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#10193a');
      g.addColorStop(0.42, '#2b4a86');
      g.addColorStop(0.72, '#e29a6b');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#f3c58f');
      x.fillStyle = g;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      // soft sun glow near the horizon
      const sun = x.createRadialGradient(W * 0.72, H * 0.78, 0, W * 0.72, H * 0.78, H * 0.55);
      sun.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,160,.85)');
      sun.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,214,160,0)');
      x.fillStyle = sun;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      // bokeh
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        x.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${rnd(0.04, 0.11)})`;
        x.beginPath();
        x.arc(rnd(0, W), rnd(0, H * 0.7), rnd(8, 34), 0, TAU);
        x.fill();
      }
      // rolling hills and grass in front
      const hill = (base, amp, col, f, ph) => {
        x.fillStyle = col;
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(0, H);
        for (let px = 0; px <= W; px += 6) x.lineTo(px, H - base - amp * Math.sin(px / f + ph));
        x.lineTo(W, H);
        x.fill();
      };
      hill(H * 0.15, H * 0.035, '#27506a', W / 5, 1);
      hill(H * 0.09, H * 0.03, '#183a4f', W / 4, 3);
      x.strokeStyle = '#0d2434';
      x.lineWidth = 1.4;
      for (let px = 0; px < W; px += 5) {
        const h = rnd(H * 0.03, H * 0.09);
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(px, H);
        x.quadraticCurveTo(px + rnd(-6, 6), H - h * 0.6, px + rnd(-10, 10), H - h);
        x.stroke();
      }
      return c;
    }

    function makePuff(R) {
      const S = R * 2.7;
      const [c, x] = offscreen(S, S);
      const m = S / 2;
      const glow = x.createRadialGradient(m, m, R * 0.2, m, m, R * 1.3);
      glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)');
      glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      x.fillStyle = glow;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
      // filaments on a sphere, back to front
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 190; i++) {
        const z = rnd(-1, 1),
          p = rnd(0, TAU),
          q = Math.sqrt(1 - z * z);
        pts.push({ x: q * Math.cos(p), y: q * Math.sin(p), z });
      }
      pts.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      x.lineCap = 'round';
      for (const p of pts) {
        const depth = (p.z + 1) / 2;
        const a = 0.22 + 0.62 * depth;
        const tx = m + p.x * R,
          ty = m + p.y * R;
        x.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.75).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.lineWidth = 0.7 + depth * 0.5;
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(m, m);
        x.lineTo(tx, ty);
        x.stroke();
        // feathery tip
        const tr = R * (0.04 + depth * 0.025);
        x.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.lineWidth = 0.6;
        for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
          const ang = (k / 10) * TAU;
          x.beginPath();
          x.moveTo(tx, ty);
          x.lineTo(tx + Math.cos(ang) * tr, ty + Math.sin(ang) * tr);
          x.stroke();
        }
        x.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.beginPath();
        x.arc(tx, ty, 1.1, 0, TAU);
        x.fill();
      }
      x.fillStyle = '#c9d49a';
      x.beginPath();
      x.arc(m, m, R * 0.055, 0, TAU);
      x.fill();
      return c;
    }

    // A seed starts on the flower (so it looks like it just left the bloom) or, at first, somewhere in the air.
    const newSeed = (anywhere) => {
      let x, y;
      if (anywhere && Math.random() < 0.5) {
        x = rnd(0, W);
        y = rnd(0, H * 0.85);
      } else {
        const a = rnd(-1.3, 1.0),
          r = geo.R * rnd(0.55, 1.0);
        x = geo.cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
        y = geo.cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
      }
      return { x, y, s: rnd(5, 11), vx: rnd(9, 20), vy: rnd(-12, -4), rot: rnd(-0.7, 0.7), ph: rnd(0, TAU), a: rnd(0.5, 0.9) };
    };
    function drawSeed(s, t) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(s.x + Math.sin(t / 900 + s.ph) * 6, s.y);
      ctx.rotate(s.rot + Math.sin(t / 1300 + s.ph) * 0.15);
      ctx.globalAlpha = s.a;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) {
        const ang = -Math.PI + (k / 10) * Math.PI;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang) * s.s, Math.sin(ang) * s.s * 0.9);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(Math.cos(ang) * s.s, Math.sin(ang) * s.s * 0.9, 0.9, 0, TAU);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s.s * 1.7);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2f26';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, s.s * 1.85, 1.1, 2.2, 0, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    function layout() {
      dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      W = Math.max(2, Math.round(r.width));
      H = Math.max(2, Math.round(r.height));
      cv.width = W * dpr;
      cv.height = H * dpr;
      geo = { cx: W * 0.52, cy: H * 0.4, R: Math.min(W * 0.33, H * 0.27) };
      bg = makeBg();
      puff = makePuff(geo.R);
      seeds = Array.from({ length: W < 500 ? 8 : 16 }, () => newSeed(true));
    }

    function draw(t, dt) {
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.drawImage(bg, 0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#2f6e4e';
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, geo.R * 0.045);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(geo.cx, geo.cy);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(geo.cx - geo.R * 0.16, (geo.cy + H) / 2, geo.cx - geo.R * 0.05, H + 10);
      ctx.stroke();
      const pw = puff.width / dpr;
      ctx.drawImage(puff, geo.cx - pw / 2, geo.cy - pw / 2, pw, pw);
      ctx.restore();
      for (const s of seeds) {
        if (!reduce) {
          s.x += s.vx * dt;
          s.y += s.vy * dt;
          if (s.x > W + 30 || s.y < -30) Object.assign(s, newSeed(false));
        }
        drawSeed(s, t);
      }
      const v = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.35, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
      v.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(5,8,20,0)');
      v.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5,8,20,.45)');
      ctx.fillStyle = v;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    function frame(now) {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - (last || now)) / 1000);
      last = now;
      draw(now, dt);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    layout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', layout);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', layout);
    };
  }

  window.LQDandelion = { icon, mount };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Accounts and cloud saves (Supabase).
 *
 * - Players can sign in with email + password or Google, or play as a guest (progress stays on this device).
 * - While signed in, the game save (and a few settings) is copied to the table public.saves and restored on
 *   any other device after signing in.
 * - Without SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in js/config.js everything here stays off and the game works as before.
 *
 * See SUPABASE_SETUP.md for the one-time setup.
 */
(function () {
  const CFG = window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG || {};
  const URL_ = String(CFG.SUPABASE_URL || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const ANON = String(CFG.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || '');
  const ENABLED = !!(URL_ && ANON);
  const SDK = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.js';

  const META_KEY = 'lq-sync-meta'; // not synced: describes this device
  const SAVE_KEY = 'english-town-save-v1';
  const PUSH_DELAY = 15000;
  const MAX_BYTES = 1500000;

  const nativeSet = Storage.prototype.setItem;
  const nativeRemove = Storage.prototype.removeItem;
  const store = window.localStorage;

  let client = null,
    user = null,
    token = '',
    suppress = false,
    blockWrites = false,
    pushTimer = 0,
    busy = false,
    statusText = '',
    chip = null,
    lastCheck = 0;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  const isSyncKey = (k) =>
    typeof k === 'string' &&
    k !== 'english-town-ai' &&
    (k === SAVE_KEY || /^lifequest[_-][a-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/i.test(k)) &&
    !/(?:key|secret|token|credential)/i.test(k);

  const syncKeys = () => {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < store.length; i++) {
      const k = store.key(i);
      if (isSyncKey(k)) out.push(k);
    }
    return out;
  };
  const snapshot = () => {
    const data = {};
    for (const k of syncKeys()) {
      const v = store.getItem(k);
      if (typeof v === 'string') data[k] = v;
    }
    return data;
  };
  const readMeta = () => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(store.getItem(META_KEY) || '{}') || {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  };
  const writeMeta = (patch) => {
    const m = Object.assign(readMeta(), patch);
    nativeSet.call(store, META_KEY, JSON.stringify(m));
    return m;
  };
  // The game saves itself on page unload; after we replaced or cleared the local data that would undo our work.
  function hardReload() {
    blockWrites = true;
    clearTimeout(pushTimer);
    location.reload();
  }
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]);

  function describe(data) {
    try {
      const g = JSON.parse(data[SAVE_KEY] || 'null');
      if (!g || !g.game) return 'No progress yet';
      const look = g.game.rpg && g.game.rpg.look;
      const parts = [];
      if (look && look.name) parts.push(look.name);
      parts.push('Day ' + (g.game.day || 1));
      parts.push('$' + (g.game.money ?? 0));
      if (g.game.rpg && g.game.rpg.xp != null) parts.push(g.game.rpg.xp + ' XP');
      return parts.join(' · ');
    } catch {
      return 'Progress could not be read';
    }
  }
  const fmtDate = (iso) => {
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    } catch {
      return iso || '';
    }
  };

  function applySnapshot(data) {
    suppress = true;
    try {
      for (const k of syncKeys()) nativeRemove.call(store, k);
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data || {})) {
        if (isSyncKey(k) && typeof v === 'string' && v.length < 2e6) nativeSet.call(store, k, v);
      }
    } finally {
      suppress = false;
    }
  }

  // ---------- UI ----------
  const CSS = `
#lq-auth{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:97;background:#05080ef2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box;font:15px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eef3ff}

#lq-auth.split .or::before,#lq-auth.split .or::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:#222c52}
#lq-auth.split .note{background:#1a2347;border:1px solid #2c3866;color:#c8d3f2;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:10px}
#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .tabs,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .field,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-go,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-forgot,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-google,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .or{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
#lq-auth.split .ffoot{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#5f6d96}
#lq-auth.split .msg{min-height:16px;margin-top:6px}#lq-auth.split .link{padding:2px 0 0}
#lq-auth.split .apane{box-sizing:border-box;flex:1 1 60%;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#lq-auth.split .apane canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#lq-auth.split .quote{position:absolute;left:34px;bottom:26px;margin:0;max-width:60%;font-size:15px;font-style:italic;color:#ffffffd9;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #0008}
@media (max-width:820px){#lq-auth.split{flex-direction:column-reverse}#lq-auth.split .fpane{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;justify-content:flex-start;padding:22px 20px 40px}#lq-auth.split .apane{flex:0 0 26vh}#lq-auth.split .quote{display:none}}
`;
  function addCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('lq-auth-css')) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'lq-auth-css';
    st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  function overlay(html, split) {
    addCss();
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'lq-auth';
    if (split) {
      el.className = 'split';
      el.innerHTML = html;
    } else el.innerHTML = '<div class="card">' + html + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  }
  const GOOGLE_G =
    '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 9.5c3.5 0 6.6 1.2 9.1 3.6l6.8-6.8C35.8 2.4 30.3 0 24 0 14.6 0 6.5 5.4 2.6 13.2l7.9 6.1C12.4 13.6 17.7 9.5 24 9.5z"/><path fill="#4285F4" d="M46.5 24.5c0-1.6-.1-3.1-.4-4.5H24v9h12.7c-.6 3-2.3 5.5-4.8 7.2l7.5 5.8c4.4-4.1 7.1-10.1 7.1-17.5z"/><path fill="#FBBC05" d="M10.5 28.7a14.5 14.5 0 010-9.4l-7.9-6.1a24 24 0 000 21.6l7.9-6.1z"/><path fill="#34A853" d="M24 48c6.5 0 11.9-2.1 15.9-5.8l-7.5-5.8c-2.1 1.4-4.9 2.3-8.4 2.3-6.3 0-11.6-4.1-13.5-9.8l-7.9 6.1C6.5 42.6 14.6 48 24 48z"/></svg>';

  function showLogin({ allowGuest, disabled }) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let mode = 'in';
      const art = window.LQDandelion;
      const el = overlay(
        `
        <section class="fpane">
          <div class="fwrap${disabled ? ' off' : ''}">
            <div class="brand"><div class="ico">${art ? art.icon(46) : ''}</div><div class="word"><span>LIFEQUEST</span><b>AI</b></div></div>
            <h2>Welcome</h2>
            <p class="sub">Sign in to save your progress and keep playing on any device.</p>
            ${disabled ? '<div class="note">Sign-in is not enabled in this build. You can still play as a guest right now.</div>' : ''}
            <div class="tabs"><button type="button" data-m="in" class="on">Sign in</button><button type="button" data-m="up">Sign up</button></div>
            <div class="field"><label for="lq-a-mail">Email</label><input id="lq-a-mail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com"></div>
            <div class="field"><label for="lq-a-pass">Password</label><input id="lq-a-pass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="At least 6 characters"></div>
            <button type="button" class="btn primary" id="lq-a-go">Sign in</button>
            <div class="msg" id="lq-a-msg" role="status"></div>
            <button type="button" class="link" id="lq-a-forgot">Forgot password?</button>
            <div class="or">or</div>
            <button type="button" class="btn google" id="lq-a-google">${GOOGLE_G}<span>Continue with Google</span></button>
            ${allowGuest ? '<button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="lq-a-guest">Play as guest</button>' : '<button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="lq-a-cancel">Close</button>'}
          </div>
          <div class="ffoot">by the New Horizons</div>
        </section>
        <section class="apane"><canvas aria-hidden="true"></canvas><p class="quote">“Every sentence you speak is a seed.”</p></section>
      `,
        true,
      );
      const stopArt = art ? art.mount(el.querySelector('canvas')) : () => {};
      const $ = (s) => el.querySelector(s);
      const say = (t, cls) => {
        const m = $('#lq-a-msg');
        m.textContent = t;
        m.className = 'msg ' + (cls || '');
      };
      const setBusy = (b) => el.querySelectorAll('button,input').forEach((x) => (x.disabled = b));
      const finish = (v) => {
        stopArt();
        el.remove();
        resolve(v);
      };
      if (disabled) el.querySelectorAll('.tabs button,#lq-a-mail,#lq-a-pass,#lq-a-go,#lq-a-google,#lq-a-forgot').forEach((x) => (x.disabled = true));
      // Nút Google ẩn cho đến khi Supabase xác nhận nhà cung cấp Google đã bật
      // (chưa bật mà bấm thì ra trang lỗi "Unsupported provider: provider is not enabled").
      if (!disabled) {
        const g = $('#lq-a-google');
        const or = $('.or');
        g.hidden = or.hidden = true;
        fetch(URL_ + '/auth/v1/settings', { headers: { apikey: ANON } })
          .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
          .then((s) => {
            if (s && s.external && s.external.google) g.hidden = or.hidden = false;
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
      el.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
        const b = ev.target.closest('button');
        if (!b || b.disabled) return;
        if (b.dataset.m) {
          mode = b.dataset.m;
          el.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach((x) => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b));
          $('#lq-a-go').textContent = mode === 'in' ? 'Sign in' : 'Create account';
          $('#lq-a-pass').autocomplete = mode === 'in' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password';
          say('');
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-guest') return finish('guest');
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-cancel') return finish('cancel');
        const email = $('#lq-a-mail').value.trim();
        const pass = $('#lq-a-pass').value;
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-google') {
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            const r = await client.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname } });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
          } catch (e) {
            setBusy(false);
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-forgot') {
          if (!email) return say('Enter your email above, then tap again.', 'err');
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            const r = await client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
            say('Password reset email sent. Please check your inbox.', 'ok');
          } catch (e) {
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          setBusy(false);
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-go') {
          if (!email || !pass) return say('Please enter your email and password.', 'err');
          if (mode === 'up' && pass.length < 6) return say('Password must be at least 6 characters.', 'err');
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            say('Working…');
            if (mode === 'in') {
              const r = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password: pass });
              if (r.error) throw r.error;
              user = r.data.user;
              token = r.data.session ? r.data.session.access_token : '';
              return finish('user');
            }
            const r = await client.auth.signUp({ email, password: pass, options: { emailRedirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname } });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
            if (r.data.session) {
              user = r.data.user;
              token = r.data.session.access_token;
              return finish('user');
            }
            say('Account created. Open your email to confirm, then come back and sign in.', 'ok');
          } catch (e) {
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          setBusy(false);
        }
      });
      el.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if (ev.key === 'Enter' && ev.target.tagName === 'INPUT' && !disabled) $('#lq-a-go').click();
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        const f = disabled ? $('#lq-a-guest') : $('#lq-a-mail');
        if (f) f.focus();
      }, 60);
    });
  }
  function friendly(e) {
    const m = String((e && e.message) || e || '');
    if (/invalid login/i.test(m)) return 'Incorrect email or password.';
    if (/already registered|already been registered/i.test(m)) return 'This email already has an account. Please sign in.';
    if (/email not confirmed/i.test(m)) return 'Email not confirmed yet. Please check your inbox.';
    if (/rate limit|too many/i.test(m)) return 'Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.';
    if (/password/i.test(m)) return 'Invalid password (at least 6 characters).';
    if (/network|fetch/i.test(m)) return 'Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.';
    return m || 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.';
  }

  function chooseSave(local, cloud, why) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const el = overlay(`
        <h2>Choose which progress to use</h2>
        <p class="sub">${esc(why)}</p>
        <div class="cmp">
          <div><b>☁️ On the server (updated ${esc(fmtDate(cloud.updated_at))})</b>${esc(describe(cloud.data.data || {}))}</div>
          <div><b>💻 On this device</b>${esc(describe(local))}</div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn primary" data-c="cloud">Use server progress</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn ghost" data-c="local">Use this device's progress (overwrites server)</button>
      `);
      el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        const b = ev.target.closest('button');
        if (!b) return;
        el.remove();
        resolve(b.dataset.c);
      });
    });
  }

  // ---------- cloud ----------
  async function loadSdk() {
    if (window.supabase && window.supabase.createClient) return;
    // Offline or a very slow school network: give up quickly and let the game start as a guest.
    if (navigator.onLine === false) throw new Error('No Internet connection');
    await new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      const timer = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('The sign-in library took too long to load')), 8000);
      s.src = SDK;
      s.onload = () => { clearTimeout(timer); res(); };
      s.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(timer); rej(new Error('Could not load the sign-in library')); };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  async function fetchRow() {
    const r = await client.from('saves').select('data,updated_at').eq('user_id', user.id).maybeSingle();
    if (r.error) throw r.error;
    return r.data || null;
  }

  function sameData(a, b) {
    const ka = Object.keys(a).sort(),
      kb = Object.keys(b).sort();
    return ka.length === kb.length && ka.every((k, i) => k === kb[i] && a[k] === b[k]);
  }

  async function push(opts = {}) {
    if (!user || !client || busy) return false;
    busy = true;
    setStatus('sync');
    try {
      const data = snapshot();
      if (!data[SAVE_KEY]) {
        setStatus('ok');
        return true;
      }
      const body = { v: 1, data, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      if (JSON.stringify(body).length > MAX_BYTES) throw new Error('Save data is too large');
      const meta = readMeta();
      if (!opts.force) {
        const row = await fetchRow();
        if (row && row.updated_at !== meta.lastCloudAt && !sameData(row.data.data || {}, data)) {
          busy = false;
          const pick = await chooseSave(data, row, 'Server progress was changed from another device.');
          if (pick === 'cloud') {
            applySnapshot(row.data.data || {});
            writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false });
            hardReload();
            return false;
          }
          return await push({ force: true });
        }
      }
      const r = await client.from('saves').upsert({ user_id: user.id, data: body }).select('updated_at').single();
      if (r.error) throw r.error;
      writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: r.data.updated_at, dirty: false, guest: false });
      setStatus('ok');
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('cloud save failed', e);
      setStatus('bad', friendly(e));
      return false;
    } finally {
      busy = false;
    }
  }

  // Best-effort save while the tab is closing (fetch with keepalive survives page unload).
  function pushOnLeave() {
    if (!user || !token || !readMeta().dirty) return;
    const data = snapshot();
    if (!data[SAVE_KEY]) return;
    const body = JSON.stringify({ user_id: user.id, data: { v: 1, data, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() } });
    if (body.length > 60000) return; // keepalive requests are limited to 64 KB
    try {
      fetch(URL_ + '/rest/v1/saves?on_conflict=user_id', {
        method: 'POST',
        keepalive: true,
        headers: { apikey: ANON, Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Prefer: 'resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal' },
        body,
      });
      writeMeta({ dirty: false, lastCloudAt: '' });
    } catch (e) {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }

  function markDirty() {
    const m = readMeta();
    if (!m.dirty) writeMeta({ dirty: true });
    if (user) {
      setStatus('sync');
      clearTimeout(pushTimer);
      pushTimer = setTimeout(() => push(), PUSH_DELAY);
    }
  }

  /** Decide which copy to keep after signing in. Returns 'applied' when this device's data was replaced. */
  async function reconcile() {
    const meta = readMeta();
    const row = await fetchRow();
    const local = snapshot();
    const hasLocal = !!local[SAVE_KEY];
    if (!row) {
      if (hasLocal) await push({ force: true });
      else writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: '', dirty: false, guest: false });
      return 'kept';
    }
    const cloudData = row.data.data || {};
    if (hasLocal && sameData(cloudData, local)) {
      writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false, guest: false });
      return 'kept';
    }
    if (!hasLocal) {
      applySnapshot(cloudData);
      writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false, guest: false });
      return 'applied';
    }
    if (meta.userId === user.id && row.updated_at === meta.lastCloudAt) {
      if (meta.dirty) await push({ force: true });
      return 'kept';
    }
    if (meta.userId === user.id && !meta.dirty) {
      applySnapshot(cloudData);
      writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false });
      return 'applied';
    }
    const why = meta.userId === user.id ? 'Both places have unsynced changes.' : 'This device has game progress (guest or another account), and your account also has progress on the server.';
    const pick = await chooseSave(local, row, why);
    if (pick === 'cloud') {
      applySnapshot(cloudData);
      writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false, guest: false });
      return 'applied';
    }
    await push({ force: true });
    return 'kept';
  }

  async function checkRemote() {
    if (!user || busy || Date.now() - lastCheck < 20000) return;
    lastCheck = Date.now();
    try {
      const row = await fetchRow();
      const meta = readMeta();
      if (!row || row.updated_at === meta.lastCloudAt) return;
      if (sameData(row.data.data || {}, snapshot())) {
        writeMeta({ lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false });
        return;
      }
      if (meta.dirty) await push();
      else showBanner('Newer progress is available from another device.', 'Reload', () => reloadWithCloud(row));
    } catch (e) {
      /* offline: ignore */
    }
  }
  function reloadWithCloud(row) {
    applySnapshot(row.data.data || {});
    writeMeta({ userId: user.id, lastCloudAt: row.updated_at, dirty: false });
    hardReload();
  }
  function showBanner(text, label, fn) {
    addCss();
    let b = document.getElementById('lq-banner');
    if (b) b.remove();
    b = document.createElement('div');
    b.id = 'lq-banner';
    b.innerHTML = '<span>' + esc(text) + '</span><button type="button">' + esc(label) + '</button>';
    b.querySelector('button').onclick = fn;
    document.body.appendChild(b);
  }

  // ---------- account chip ----------
  function setStatus(kind, text) {
    statusText = text || '';
    if (!chip) return;
    const dot = chip.querySelector('.dot');
    if (dot) dot.className = 'dot ' + (kind === 'ok' ? 'ok' : kind === 'sync' ? 'sync' : kind === 'bad' ? 'bad' : '');
    const note = chip.querySelector('.note');
    if (note) note.textContent = kind === 'bad' ? 'Sync error: ' + statusText : kind === 'sync' ? 'Syncing…' : kind === 'ok' ? 'Synced' : '';
  }

  function lookName() {
    try {
      const sc = window.__lifequestGetScene && window.__lifequestGetScene();
      return (sc && sc.store.game.rpg.look.name) || '';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  }

  function mountChip() {
    addCss();
    if (!chip) {
      chip = document.createElement('div');
      chip.id = 'lq-chip';
      document.body.appendChild(chip);
      chip.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
        const b = ev.target.closest('button');
        if (!b) return;
        if (b.dataset.a === 'toggle') return chip.classList.toggle('open');
        chip.classList.remove('open');
        if (b.dataset.a === 'look') return window.LQCreatorUI && window.LQCreatorUI.open({});
        if (b.dataset.a === 'sync') return push();
        if (b.dataset.a === 'out') return signOut();
        if (b.dataset.a === 'in') {
          const r = await showLogin({ allowGuest: false });
          if (r === 'user') {
            const res = await reconcile();
            hardReload();
          }
        }
      });
      document.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        if (!chip.contains(ev.target)) chip.classList.remove('open');
      });
    }
    render();
    setInterval(render, 5000);
  }
  function render() {
    if (!chip) return;
    const name = lookName();
    const label = user ? name || user.email || 'Account' : name ? name + ' (guest)' : 'Guest';
    chip.innerHTML = `<button type="button" data-a="toggle"><span class="dot"></span>${user ? '👤' : '🎮'} ${esc(label)}</button>
      <div class="menu">
        ${user ? `<p>${esc(user.email || '')}<br><span class="note"></span></p><button type="button" data-a="sync">🔄 Sync now</button>` : ENABLED ? '<p>Playing as a guest. Progress is saved only on this device.</p><button type="button" data-a="in">🔐 Sign in / Sign up</button>' : '<p>Progress is saved on this device.</p>'}
        <button type="button" data-a="look">🎭 Change character</button>
        ${user ? '<button type="button" data-a="out">🚪 Sign out</button>' : ''}
      </div>`;
    setStatus(user ? (readMeta().dirty ? 'sync' : 'ok') : '', statusText);
  }

  async function signOut() {
    if (!confirm('Sign out? Your progress will be saved to the server, then removed from this device.')) return;
    try {
      clearTimeout(pushTimer);
      if (readMeta().dirty) await push({ force: false });
      if (readMeta().dirty) {
        if (!confirm('Could not save to the server. Sign out anyway and delete data on this device?')) return;
      }
      await client.auth.signOut();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
    applySnapshot({});
    nativeRemove.call(store, META_KEY);
    hardReload();
  }

  function installHooks() {
    Storage.prototype.setItem = function (k, v) {
      if (this === store && blockWrites && isSyncKey(k)) return;
      nativeSet.call(this, k, v);
      if (this === store && !suppress && isSyncKey(k)) markDirty();
    };
    Storage.prototype.removeItem = function (k) {
      if (this === store && blockWrites && isSyncKey(k)) return;
      nativeRemove.call(this, k);
      if (this === store && !suppress && isSyncKey(k)) markDirty();
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') pushOnLeave();
      else checkRemote();
    });
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', pushOnLeave);
    window.addEventListener('lifequest:lookchanged', render);
    setInterval(() => {
      if (user && readMeta().dirty && !busy && !pushTimer) pushTimer = setTimeout(() => push(), PUSH_DELAY);
    }, 60000);
  }

  // ---------- entry point (called by js/loader.js before the game starts) ----------
  async function start() {
    const boot = () => mountChipWhenReady();
    // V74 offline-first: the standalone HTML must never block game startup
    // while waiting for a Supabase SDK connection that may be unavailable.
    if (location.protocol === 'file:' || location.protocol === 'about:') {
      console.info('[LQ V74] Local game: skip remote sign-in, continue as guest.');
      boot();
      return;
    }
    if (!ENABLED) {
      await showLogin({ allowGuest: true, disabled: true });
      boot();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await loadSdk();
      client = window.supabase.createClient(URL_, ANON, { auth: { persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true, detectSessionInUrl: true } });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Đăng nhập không khả dụng:', e);
      boot();
      return;
    }
    installHooks();
    client.auth.onAuthStateChange((evt, session) => {
      token = session ? session.access_token : '';
      if (session) user = session.user;
      if (evt === 'SIGNED_OUT') user = null;
    });
    try {
      const s = await client.auth.getSession();
      if (s.data && s.data.session) {
        user = s.data.session.user;
        token = s.data.session.access_token;
      }
      if (!user) {
        const r = await showLogin({ allowGuest: true });
        if (r === 'guest') writeMeta({ guest: true });
      }
      if (user) await reconcile();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Không đồng bộ được lúc khởi động:', e);
      setStatus('bad', friendly(e));
    }
    boot();
  }

  function mountChipWhenReady() {
    const go = () => mountChip();
    if (document.body) go();
    else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', go);
  }

  window.LQAuth = { start, enabled: ENABLED, syncNow: () => push(), signOut, getUser: () => user };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Character creator.
 * Lets the player pick a name, gender, skin, hair (style / colour), eyes, clothes, hat, glasses, backpack.
 * The result is stored in the game save at game.rpg.look, so it follows the account across devices.
 * Sprite drawing lives in js/game/10-core-characters-and-scene.js (window.LQCharacter).
 */
(function () {
  const SKINS = [0xffe0c8, 0xf6d2b0, 0xe8b88a, 0xc98e62, 0x8d5a3a, 0x5b3a29];
  const HAIRS = [0x1b1b1b, 0x3a2418, 0x5a3b2a, 0x8a5a3b, 0xe3c16f, 0xb5532a, 0xb8b8b8, 0xeeeeee, 0x3f6fd1, 0xe56fa8, 0x3fae6a, 0xd9877a, 0xc8702a, 0x2a3a35];
  const EYES = [0x222233, 0x5a3a22, 0x2f6fd0, 0x2f9e55, 0x7a8794, 0x7a3fbf, 0x55c8ff];
  const OUTFITS = [0x3a63c8, 0xb8433f, 0x3f9b5a, 0xe0a63a, 0x7a4fb5, 0x2f8f8a, 0xd9d9d9, 0x2b2f3a, 0xe56fa8, 0x8a5a3b, 0xff8a3d, 0x5a84bb];
  const PANTS = [0x2d3a55, 0x3b3b3b, 0x6b4a2e, 0x4a5a3a, 0x2b2f3a, 0x7a7f8a, 0x8a4b2a, 0xb8433f];
  const HAT_COLORS = [0x2f7de1, 0xb8433f, 0x3f9b5a, 0xe0a63a, 0x2b2f3a, 0xeeeeee, 0x7a4fb5];
  const HATS = [
    ['none', 'No hat'],
    ['cap', 'Cap'],
    ['police', 'Police cap'],
    ['chef', 'Chef hat'],
    ['helmet', 'Hard hat'],
  ];
  const STYLES = [
    ['short', 'Short'],
    ['long', 'Long'],
    ['bob', 'Shoulder-length'],
    ['ponytail', 'Ponytail'],
    ['bun', 'Bun'],
    ['spiky', 'Upright'],
    ['curly', 'Curly'],
    ['bald', 'Bald'],
    ['storm', 'Storm spikes'],
    ['scruffy', 'Short scruffy'],
    ['thorn', 'Sharp spikes'],
    ['flare', 'Chin-length flared'],
    ['highpony', 'High ponytail'],
    ['longbun', 'Long half-bun'],
    ['swept', 'Swept back'],
    ['blaze', 'Wild spikes'],
    ['tousled', 'Lightly tousled'],
    ['crop', 'Cropped messy'],
    ['ryomen', 'Pink upright spikes'],
    ['urchin', 'Urchin spikes'],
  ];
  // Hair colour suggested when one of the styles below is picked (can be changed afterwards).
  const STYLE_COLORS = { storm: 0xeeeeee, scruffy: 0xd9877a, thorn: 0x1b1b1b, flare: 0xc8702a, highpony: 0x2a3a35, longbun: 0x1b1b1b, swept: 0xe3c16f, blaze: 0xd9877a, tousled: 0x1b1b1b, crop: 0x1b1b1b, ryomen: 0xea8fa0, urchin: 0x15192a };
  const STYLE_ALIAS = { gojo: 'storm', itadori: 'scruffy', megumi: 'thorn', nobara: 'flare', maki: 'highpony', geto: 'longbun', nanami: 'swept', sukuna: 'blaze', yuta: 'tousled', toji: 'crop' };
  const BAGS = [0x8a4b2a, 0x3a63c8, 0xb8433f, 0x2b2f3a];

  // Ready-made characters. Picking one fills in the whole look; the player's own name is kept and everything can
  // still be changed afterwards.
  const SCHOOL = 0x1f2a44;
  const PRESETS = [
    { name: 'The Honored One', lock: 'mineral-trip', note: 'The strongest sorcerer: white hair, blindfold, high-collared black uniform, Infinity aura. Tap Ctrl to open the Six Eyes and see through walls', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xffe0c8, hair: 0xf4f7ff, style: 'storm', eye: 0x55c8ff, eyeGlow: true, blindfold: true, aura: 'infinity', sixEyes: true, outfit: 0x14141b, pants: 0x14141b, uniform: true, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Cursed King', lock: 'sukuna-fingers', note: 'King of Curses: pink upright spiky hair, four red eyes, face markings, white kimono', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0xea8fa0, style: 'ryomen', eye: 0xc02a2a, extraEyes: true, faceMarks: true, kimono: true, outfit: 0xe9e4d6, pants: 0x24242d, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Potential Gentleman', lock: 'ten-shadows', note: 'Cold and calm shadow user: black sea-urchin spikes, black eyes, navy high-collared uniform. Tap Ctrl to summon the Divine Dog and ride it', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0x15192a, style: 'urchin', eye: 0x16161e, outfit: 0x12172a, pants: 0x0d111d, uniform: true, trim: 0x2a3f66, shadow: true, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Haru', note: 'Short scruffy pink-orange hair', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0xd9877a, style: 'scruffy', eye: 0x7a4a22, outfit: SCHOOL, pants: SCHOOL, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Kuro', note: 'Black sharp-spiked hair', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0x1b1b1b, style: 'thorn', eye: 0x2a5a6a, outfit: SCHOOL, pants: SCHOOL, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Mika', note: 'Orange chin-length flared hair, dress', look: { gender: 'female', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0xc8702a, style: 'flare', eye: 0x7a4a22, outfit: SCHOOL, pants: SCHOOL, dress: true, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Sora', note: 'High ponytail, glasses', look: { gender: 'female', skin: 0xe8b88a, hair: 0x2a3a35, style: 'highpony', eye: 0x2f9e55, outfit: SCHOOL, pants: SCHOOL, glasses: true, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Ryu', note: 'Long black hair, half-bun', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0x1b1b1b, style: 'longbun', eye: 0x222233, outfit: 0x1b1b24, pants: 0x1b1b24, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Daiki', note: 'Blond swept-back hair, beige suit, tie', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0xe3c16f, style: 'swept', eye: 0x5a3a22, outfit: 0xc9b48a, pants: 0xc9b48a, glasses: true, collar: true, tie: 0xf0c040, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Akira', note: 'Wild pink spiky hair, red eyes', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0xd9877a, style: 'blaze', eye: 0xc0392b, outfit: 0xe8e4d8, pants: 0x2b2f3a, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Yuki', note: 'Lightly tousled black hair, white uniform', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xf6d2b0, hair: 0x1b1b1b, style: 'tousled', eye: 0x222233, outfit: 0xf2f2f2, pants: 0xf2f2f2, collar: true, hat: null } },
    { name: 'Tora', note: 'Short black hair, green eyes', look: { gender: 'male', skin: 0xe8b88a, hair: 0x1b1b1b, style: 'crop', eye: 0x2f9e55, outfit: 0x1b1b1b, pants: 0x2b2f3a, hat: null } },
  ];
  const pick = (a) => a[Math.floor(Math.random() * a.length)];
  const hex = (n) => '#' + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, '0');

  function defaults(gender) {
    return gender === 'female'
      ? { name: '', gender, skin: SKINS[1], hair: HAIRS[1], style: 'long', eye: EYES[1], outfit: OUTFITS[1], pants: PANTS[0], hat: null, glasses: false, dress: true, backpack: 0, blindfold: false, collar: false, tie: null }
      : { name: '', gender: 'male', skin: SKINS[1], hair: HAIRS[2], style: 'short', eye: EYES[0], outfit: OUTFITS[0], pants: PANTS[0], hat: { kind: 'cap', color: HAT_COLORS[0] }, glasses: false, dress: false, backpack: 0, blindfold: false, collar: false, tie: null };
  }

  const CSS = `
#lq-cc{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:96;background:#05080ef0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;font:14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-cc[hidden]{display:none}
#lq-cc .box{width:min(920px,100%);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;background:#141824;border:2px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000a}
#lq-cc h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:20px;color:#ffd36b}
#lq-cc .sub{color:#a9b8d0;margin:0 0 12px}
#lq-cc .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr;gap:18px}
@media(max-width:700px){#lq-cc .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#lq-cc .prev{background:linear-gradient(#27405a,#1b2a3c);border:2px solid #34506e;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;text-align:center}
#lq-cc canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;width:192px;height:400px;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px}
#lq-cc .dirs{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
#lq-cc button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#lq-cc .dirs button,#lq-cc .opt button,#lq-cc .gender button{background:#1f2a3d;color:#eef3ff;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 9px}
#lq-cc .dirs button.on,#lq-cc .opt button.on,#lq-cc .gender button.on{border-color:#ffd36b;background:#33405a;color:#fff}
#lq-cc .row{margin:0 0 10px}
#lq-cc .row>b{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;color:#ffd36b;font-size:13px}
#lq-cc .sw{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#lq-cc .sw button{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #0008;padding:0}
#lq-cc .sw button.on{border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffd36b}
#lq-cc .opt{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#lq-cc input[type=text]{background:#0d1320;color:#fff;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;font:inherit;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
#lq-cc .foot{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;bottom:-16px;background:#141824;padding:10px 0 4px}
#lq-cc .foot button{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:700}
#lq-cc .ok{background:#f3b94d;color:#1b2630}
#lq-cc .ghost{background:#2a3550;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-cc .err{color:#ff9a9a;min-height:18px;margin-top:6px}
#lq-cc .tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
#lq-cc .tabs button{flex:1;background:#1f2a3d;color:#eef3ff;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:9px;padding:8px}
#lq-cc .tabs button.on{background:#33405a;border-color:#ffd36b}
#lq-cc .gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
#lq-cc .card{background:#1a2438;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:12px;padding:8px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-cc .card:hover{border-color:#ffd36b;background:#243250}
#lq-cc .card canvas{width:72px;height:150px;margin:0 auto 4px}
#lq-cc .card.locked{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.85}
#lq-cc .card.locked canvas{filter:brightness(0) opacity(.55)}
#lq-cc .card.locked span{color:#ffb4b4}
#lq-cc .card b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#ffd36b}
#lq-cc .card span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#a9b8d0}
#lq-cc .hint{color:#a9b8d0;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 10px}
`;

  let root = null,
    look = null,
    dir = 'down',
    tab = 'custom',
    onDone = null,
    mandatory = false,
    guard = null;

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);

  function currentLook() {
    const sc = getScene();
    return sc && sc.store && sc.store.game && sc.store.game.rpg ? sc.store.game.rpg.look : null;
  }

  function draw() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!root || !sc || !look) return;
    const cv = root.querySelector('canvas'),
      cx = cv.getContext('2d');
    cx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
    cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    try {
      const img = window.LQCharacter.imageFor(sc, look, dir === 'left' ? 'side' : dir, 0);
      cx.save();
      if (dir === 'left') {
        cx.translate(cv.width, 0);
        cx.scale(-1, 1);
      }
      cx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      cx.restore();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('creator preview failed', e);
    }
  }

  function swatches(field, colors, hatColor) {
    return colors
      .map((c) => {
        const on = hatColor ? look.hat && look.hat.color === c : look[field] === c;
        return `<button type="button" data-f="${hatColor ? 'hatcolor' : field}" data-v="${c}" class="${on ? 'on' : ''}" style="background:${hex(c)}" aria-label="${hex(c)}"></button>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  function presetLook(p) {
    return Object.assign(defaults(p.look.gender), p.look);
  }

  // A preset with `lock` stays unavailable until that achievement is completed (see achievements.js).
  const isLocked = (p) => !!p.lock && !(window.LQAchievements && window.LQAchievements.isUnlocked(p.lock));

  function renderGallery() {
    return `<p class="hint">Pick a character as your starting point (your name is kept). You can still customise it further in the "Customise" tab. Characters with 🔒 need an achievement from the Menu to unlock.</p>
      <div class="gal">${PRESETS.map((p, i) => (isLocked(p)
        ? `<button type="button" class="card locked" data-lock="${p.lock}"><canvas width="24" height="50" data-pc="${i}"></canvas><b>🔒 ${p.name}</b><span>Achievement required</span></button>`
        : `<button type="button" class="card" data-p="${i}"><canvas width="24" height="50" data-pc="${i}"></canvas><b>${p.name}</b><span>${p.note}</span></button>`)).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function drawGalleryThumbs() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc) return;
    root.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-pc]').forEach((cv) => {
      const cx = cv.getContext('2d');
      cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      try {
        cx.drawImage(window.LQCharacter.imageFor(sc, presetLook(PRESETS[Number(cv.dataset.pc)]), 'down', 0), 0, 0);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('thumbnail failed', e);
      }
    });
  }

  function renderCustom() {
    const hatKind = look.hat ? look.hat.kind : 'none';
    return `
      <div class="row gender"><b>Gender</b><div class="opt"><button type="button" data-g="male" class="${look.gender === 'male' ? 'on' : ''}">👦 Male</button><button type="button" data-g="female" class="${look.gender === 'female' ? 'on' : ''}">👧 Female</button></div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Skin</b><div class="sw">${swatches('skin', SKINS)}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Hairstyle</b><div class="opt">${STYLES.map(([k, n]) => `<button type="button" data-f="style" data-v="${k}" class="${look.style === k ? 'on' : ''}">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Hair colour</b><div class="sw">${swatches('hair', HAIRS)}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Eye colour</b><div class="sw">${swatches('eye', EYES)}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Top</b><div class="sw">${swatches('outfit', OUTFITS)}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Trousers</b><div class="sw">${swatches('pants', PANTS)}</div></div>
      <div class="row"><b>Hat</b><div class="opt">${HATS.map(([k, n]) => `<button type="button" data-hat="${k}" class="${hatKind === k ? 'on' : ''}">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
      ${look.hat && look.hat.kind !== 'chef' ? `<div class="row"><b>Hat colour</b><div class="sw">${swatches('hat', HAT_COLORS, true)}</div></div>` : ''}
      <div class="row"><b>Accessories</b><div class="opt">
        <button type="button" data-t="glasses" class="${look.glasses ? 'on' : ''}">👓 Glasses</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="blindfold" class="${look.blindfold ? 'on' : ''}">🕶️ Blindfold</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="collar" class="${look.collar ? 'on' : ''}">👔 Collar &amp; tie</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="uniform" class="${look.uniform ? 'on' : ''}">🥋 Sorcerer uniform</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="eyeGlow" class="${look.eyeGlow ? 'on' : ''}">✨ Glowing eyes</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="extraEyes" class="${look.extraEyes ? 'on' : ''}">👁️ Four eyes</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="faceMarks" class="${look.faceMarks ? 'on' : ''}">〰️ Face markings</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="kimono" class="${look.kimono ? 'on' : ''}">👘 Kimono</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="dress" class="${look.dress ? 'on' : ''}">👗 Dress</button>
        <button type="button" data-t="backpack" class="${look.backpack ? 'on' : ''}">🎒 Backpack</button>
      </div></div>
      ${look.backpack ? `<div class="row"><b>Backpack colour</b><div class="sw">${swatches('backpack', BAGS)}</div></div>` : ''}`;
  }

  function render() {
    root.querySelector('.opts').innerHTML = `
      <div class="row"><b>Character name</b><input type="text" id="lq-cc-name" maxlength="20" placeholder="Enter your name" value="${String(look.name || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"></div>
      <div class="tabs"><button type="button" data-tab="custom" class="${tab === 'custom' ? 'on' : ''}">🎨 Customise</button><button type="button" data-tab="gallery" class="${tab === 'gallery' ? 'on' : ''}">🌟 Preset characters</button></div>
      ${tab === 'gallery' ? renderGallery() : renderCustom()}`;
    root.querySelectorAll('.dirs button').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.d === dir));
    if (tab === 'gallery') drawGalleryThumbs();
    draw();
  }
  function onClick(ev) {
    const b = ev.target.closest('button');
    if (!b || !root.contains(b)) return;
    if (b.dataset.tab) {
      tab = b.dataset.tab;
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.lock) {
      if (window.LQAchievements) window.LQAchievements.hint(b.dataset.lock);
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.p) {
      const preset = PRESETS[Number(b.dataset.p)];
      if (isLocked(preset)) return;
      const typed = (root.querySelector('#lq-cc-name') || {}).value;
      look = Object.assign(presetLook(preset), { name: (typed || look.name || '').trim() || preset.name });
      tab = 'custom';
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.d) {
      dir = b.dataset.d;
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.g) {
      const keep = look.name;
      look = Object.assign(defaults(b.dataset.g), { name: keep });
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.hat) {
      look.hat = b.dataset.hat === 'none' ? null : { kind: b.dataset.hat, color: look.hat ? look.hat.color : HAT_COLORS[0] };
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.t) {
      const t = b.dataset.t;
      if (t === 'backpack') look.backpack = look.backpack ? 0 : BAGS[0];
      else if (t === 'collar') {
        look.collar = !look.collar;
        look.tie = look.collar ? look.tie || 0xb8433f : null;
      } else look[t] = !look[t];
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.dataset.f) {
      const f = b.dataset.f,
        v = b.dataset.v;
      if (f === 'hatcolor') look.hat = { kind: look.hat.kind, color: Number(v) };
      else if (f === 'style') {
        look.style = v;
        if (STYLE_COLORS[v] !== undefined) look.hair = STYLE_COLORS[v];
      }
      else look[f] = Number(v);
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.id === 'lq-cc-random') {
      const g = pick(['male', 'female']);
      const name = look.name;
      look = Object.assign(defaults(g), {
        name,
        skin: pick(SKINS),
        hair: pick(HAIRS),
        style: pick(STYLES)[0],
        eye: pick(EYES),
        outfit: pick(OUTFITS),
        pants: pick(PANTS),
        hat: Math.random() < 0.4 ? { kind: pick(HATS.slice(1))[0], color: pick(HAT_COLORS) } : null,
        glasses: Math.random() < 0.25,
        dress: g === 'female' && Math.random() < 0.6,
        backpack: Math.random() < 0.3 ? pick(BAGS) : 0,
      });
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (b.id === 'lq-cc-save') save();
    if (b.id === 'lq-cc-cancel') close(false);
  }

  function save() {
    const name = (root.querySelector('#lq-cc-name').value || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    const err = root.querySelector('.err');
    if (!name) {
      err.textContent = 'Please enter a name for your character.';
      root.querySelector('#lq-cc-name').focus();
      return;
    }
    look.name = name.slice(0, 20);
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) {
      err.textContent = 'The game has not finished loading; try again in a moment.';
      return;
    }
    const g = sc.store.game;
    if (!g.rpg || typeof g.rpg !== 'object') g.rpg = {};
    g.rpg.look = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(look));
    sc.store.save();
    try {
      sc.applyRankLook();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('applyRankLook failed', e);
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:lookchanged', { detail: g.rpg.look }));
    close(true);
  }

  function build() {
    if (root) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
    root = document.createElement('div');
    root.id = 'lq-cc';
    root.hidden = true;
    root.innerHTML = `<div class="box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Create character">
      <h2>🎭 Create character</h2><p class="sub">Choose your look. You can change it again at any time.</p>
      <div class="grid">
        <div class="prev"><canvas width="24" height="50"></canvas>
          <div class="dirs"><button type="button" data-d="down">Front</button><button type="button" data-d="side">Right</button><button type="button" data-d="left">Left</button><button type="button" data-d="up">Back</button></div></div>
        <div class="opts"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="err" role="alert"></div>
      <div class="foot"><button type="button" class="ghost" id="lq-cc-random">🎲 Random</button><button type="button" class="ghost" id="lq-cc-cancel">Cancel</button><button type="button" class="ok" id="lq-cc-save">✔ Done</button></div>
    </div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(root);
    root.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    root.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const n = root.querySelector('#lq-cc-name');
      if (n) look.name = n.value;
    });
  }

  function open(opts = {}) {
    build();
    mandatory = !!opts.mandatory;
    onDone = opts.onDone || null;
    look = Object.assign(defaults('male'), JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentLook() || {})));
    if (STYLE_ALIAS[look.style]) look.style = STYLE_ALIAS[look.style];
    dir = 'down';
    tab = 'custom';
    root.querySelector('#lq-cc-cancel').hidden = mandatory;
    root.querySelector('.err').textContent = '';
    root.hidden = false;
    render();
    guard = (ev) => {
      const typing = ev.target && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(ev.target.tagName);
      if (ev.key === 'Escape' && !mandatory) {
        close(false);
        return;
      }
      if (typing) ev.stopPropagation();
      else {
        ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', guard, true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const n = root.querySelector('#lq-cc-name');
      if (n && !n.value) n.focus();
    }, 50);
  }

  function close(saved) {
    if (!root) return;
    root.hidden = true;
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', guard, true);
    guard = null;
    if (onDone) onDone(!!saved);
    onDone = null;
  }

  // ---- Quick switch dock: a button on the right edge that lists the ready-made characters; one click swaps the
  // look immediately (the player's own name is kept). No editing screen involved.
  const QUICK_CSS = `
#lq-quick{position:fixed;right:13px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:41;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eef3ff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px}
#lq-quick>button{background:#141824f2;color:#eef3ff;border:1px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0006}
#lq-quick>button:hover{border-color:#ffd36b}
#lq-quick .qp{display:none;width:min(280px,calc(100vw - 26px));max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;background:#141824f5;border:1px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:14px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a}
#lq-quick.open .qp{display:block}
#lq-quick .qp h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:13px;color:#ffd36b}
#lq-quick .qg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
#lq-quick .qc{background:#1a2438;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 4px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;color:#eef3ff;font:inherit}
#lq-quick .qc:hover{border-color:#ffd36b;background:#243250}
#lq-quick .qc.on{border-color:#ffd36b;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffd36b66}
#lq-quick .qc.locked{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.85}
#lq-quick .qc.locked canvas{filter:brightness(0) opacity(.55)}
#lq-quick .qc.locked b{color:#ffb4b4}
#lq-quick .qc small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#ffb4b4}
#lq-quick .qc canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;width:48px;height:100px;display:block;margin:0 auto 3px}
#lq-quick .qc b{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#ffd36b;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:700px){#lq-quick{top:auto;bottom:130px;transform:none}}
`;
  let quick = null;

  function sameLook(a, b) {
    return !!a && !!b && a.style === b.style && a.hair === b.hair && a.outfit === b.outfit && a.gender === b.gender;
  }

  function applyPreset(i) {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) return;
    const preset = PRESETS[i];
    if (!preset || isLocked(preset)) return;
    const g = sc.store.game;
    if (!g.rpg || typeof g.rpg !== 'object') g.rpg = {};
    const cur = g.rpg.look;
    const next = Object.assign(presetLook(preset), { name: ((cur && cur.name) || '').trim() || preset.name });
    g.rpg.look = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(next));
    sc.store.save();
    try {
      sc.applyRankLook();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('applyRankLook failed', e);
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:lookchanged', { detail: g.rpg.look }));
    drawQuick();
  }

  function drawQuick() {
    if (!quick) return;
    const sc = getScene();
    const cur = currentLook();
    quick.querySelectorAll('.qc').forEach((c) => {
      const i = Number(c.dataset.q);
      const locked = isLocked(PRESETS[i]);
      c.classList.toggle('locked', locked);
      c.querySelector('b').textContent = (locked ? '🔒 ' : '') + PRESETS[i].name;
      let sm = c.querySelector('small');
      if (locked && !sm) c.appendChild((sm = document.createElement('small')));
      if (sm) sm.textContent = locked ? 'Achievement required' : '';
      c.title = locked ? 'Achievement required: complete it in Menu → Achievements' : PRESETS[i].name;
      c.classList.toggle('on', !locked && sameLook(presetLook(PRESETS[i]), cur));
      const cv = c.querySelector('canvas');
      if (!sc || !cv) return;
      const cx = cv.getContext('2d');
      cx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      try {
        cx.drawImage(window.LQCharacter.imageFor(sc, presetLook(PRESETS[i]), 'down', 0), 0, 0);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('quick thumbnail failed', e);
      }
    });
  }

  function mountQuick() {
    if (quick) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.textContent = QUICK_CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
    quick = document.createElement('div');
    quick.id = 'lq-quick';
    quick.innerHTML = `<div class="qp"><h4>🎭 Choose a character</h4><div class="qg">${PRESETS.map((p, i) => `<button type="button" class="qc" data-q="${i}" title="${p.name}"><canvas width="24" height="50"></canvas><b>${p.name}</b></button>`).join('')}</div></div><button type="button" data-qt="1">🎭 Character</button>`;
    document.body.appendChild(quick);
    quick.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      const b = ev.target.closest('button');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.qt) {
        quick.classList.toggle('open');
        if (quick.classList.contains('open')) drawQuick();
      } else if (b.dataset.q !== undefined) {
        const p = PRESETS[Number(b.dataset.q)];
        if (isLocked(p)) {
          if (window.LQAchievements) window.LQAchievements.hint(p.lock);
