        } else applyPreset(Number(b.dataset.q));
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('lifequest:achievements', drawQuick);
    document.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
      if (quick && !quick.contains(ev.target)) quick.classList.remove('open');
    });
    window.addEventListener('lifequest:lookchanged', drawQuick);
  }

  // A save that already wears a locked character (e.g. Gojo picked before the lock existed) is switched to the first
  // unlocked preset, keeping the player's name.
  function enforceLocks() {
    const cur = currentLook();
    if (!cur) return;
    const locked = PRESETS.find((p) => isLocked(p) && cur.style === p.look.style && cur.hair === p.look.hair && !!cur.uniform === !!p.look.uniform);
    if (!locked) return;
    const i = PRESETS.findIndex((p) => !isLocked(p));
    if (i >= 0) {
      applyPreset(i);
      if (window.LQAchievements) window.LQAchievements.hint(locked.lock);
    }
  }

  // Open the creator by itself the first time a player enters the game.
  function watch() {
    let tries = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      tries++;
      const sc = getScene();
      if (sc && sc.player && sc.store && sc.store.game) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        mountQuick();
        enforceLocks();
        if (!currentLook()) open({ mandatory: true });
      } else if (tries > 240) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 500);
  }

  window.LQCreatorUI = { open, close, watch, hasLook: () => !!currentLook(), currentLook, presets: PRESETS, presetLook, applyPreset };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * LifeQuest achievements.
 * Each achievement has steps that are detected from the game state (the area the player is standing in) and an
 * optional reward: unlocking a ready-made character. Progress is stored in the normal save (game.ach), so it syncs
 * and survives reloads. The Menu gets an "Achievements" page that renders from ACHIEVEMENTS.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const MINE = 'mining-town';
  const TOWN = 'english-town';

  // reward.character = name of a PRESETS entry in creator.js that stays locked until this achievement is done.
  const ACHIEVEMENTS = [
    {
      id: 'mineral-trip',
      icon: '🚂',
      title: 'Minerals Town Trip',
      desc: 'Take the train to Minerals Town, step into the mining town, then return to English Town.',
      hint: 'Buy a ticket at the English Town train station to reach Minerals Town. To go back, step onto the glowing tile in the south-west corner of Minerals Town, or take the train back.',
      steps: [
        { id: 'visit', text: 'Set foot in Minerals Town' },
        { id: 'return', text: 'Return to English Town' },
      ],
      reward: { character: 'The Honored One' },
    },
    {
      id: 'sukuna-fingers',
      icon: '👆',
      title: "The Cursed King's Twenty Fingers",
      desc: "The King of Curses' twenty cursed fingers are scattered across the towns. Find and collect all 20 of them.",
      hint: 'The fingers glow purple. Walk close to one to pick it up. Explore every corner, both outdoors and indoors.',
      counter: () => (window.LQFingers ? { done: window.LQFingers.count(), total: window.LQFingers.total } : null),
      reward: { character: 'Cursed King' },
    },
    {
      id: 'ten-shadows',
      icon: '🌑',
      title: 'The Ten Shadows',
      desc: 'An old legend tells of ten shadow beasts that left their marks across both towns. Learn the legend and find all ten shadows.',
      hint: 'Ask Ms. Green in the Library about the Ten Shadows, then ask the villagers about the shadows. Each one knows a story and a clue to where a mark is hidden. Check the quest panel (V) for your next clue.',
      counter: () => (window.LQTenShadows ? { done: window.LQTenShadows.count(), total: window.LQTenShadows.total } : null),
      reward: { character: 'Potential Gentleman' },
    },
  ];

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);
  const esc = (s) =>
    String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]);

  function state(create) {
    const sc = getScene();
    const g = sc && sc.store && sc.store.game;
    if (!g) return null;
    if (!g.ach || typeof g.ach !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return { steps: {}, done: {} };
      g.ach = { steps: {}, done: {} };
    }
    if (!g.ach.steps) g.ach.steps = {};
    if (!g.ach.done) g.ach.done = {};
    return g.ach;
  }

  const isUnlocked = (id) => !!(state(false) || { done: {} }).done[id];
  const byId = (id) => ACHIEVEMENTS.find((a) => a.id === id);
  const stepDone = (a, sid) => !!((state(false) || { steps: {} }).steps[a.id + ':' + sid]);

  function persist() {
    const sc = getScene();
    try {
      sc.store.save();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('achievement save failed', e);
    }
  }

  // ---- notification -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const TOAST_CSS = `
#lq-ach-toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:16px;transform:translate(-50%,-140%);z-index:9500;min-width:260px;max-width:min(420px,calc(100vw - 24px));background:linear-gradient(#2b2347,#171326);border:2px solid #ffd36b;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #000a;color:#eef3ff;font:14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1.2,.3,1);cursor:pointer}
#lq-ach-toast.on{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#lq-ach-toast small{display:block;color:#ffd36b;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:2px}
#lq-ach-toast b{display:block;font-size:15px}
#lq-ach-toast p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#cdd7ee;font-size:13px}
`;
  let toastEl = null,
    toastTimer = 0;

  function toast(kicker, title, text) {
    if (!toastEl) {
      const st = document.createElement('style');
      st.textContent = TOAST_CSS;
      document.head.appendChild(st);
      toastEl = document.createElement('div');
      toastEl.id = 'lq-ach-toast';
      toastEl.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      toastEl.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toastEl.classList.remove('on');
        if (window.LQ11_UI) window.LQ11_UI.open('achievements');
      });
      document.body.appendChild(toastEl);
    }
    toastEl.innerHTML = `<small>${esc(kicker)}</small><b>${esc(title)}</b><p>${esc(text)}</p>`;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => toastEl.classList.add('on'));
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.remove('on'), 7000);
  }

  function hint(id) {
    const a = byId(id);
    if (a) toast('🔒 Achievement required', a.title, 'See how to unlock it in Menu → Achievements.');
  }

  function complete(a) {
    const st = state(true);
    if (!st || st.done[a.id]) return;
    st.done[a.id] = Date.now();
    persist();
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:achievements', { detail: { id: a.id } }));
    const reward = a.reward && a.reward.character ? `Unlocked the character ${a.reward.character}! Open Menu → Achievements to wear it.` : 'You completed the achievement.';
    toast('🏆 Achievement completed', a.title, reward);
    if (window.LQ11_UI && document.getElementById('l11-shell') && !document.getElementById('l11-shell').hidden)
      window.LQ11_UI.page('achievements');
  }

  // ---- progress tracking --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function mark(a, sid) {
    const st = state(true);
    const key = a.id + ':' + sid;
    if (!st || st.steps[key]) return false;
    st.steps[key] = Date.now();
    persist();
    return true;
  }

  let greeting = false;
  function tick() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!sc || !sc.area || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) return;
    const area = sc.area.id;
    const a = byId('mineral-trip');
    if (!a || isUnlocked(a.id) || greeting) return;
    // Progress is recorded silently; the how-to lives only on the Menu → Achievements page.
    if (area === MINE) mark(a, 'visit');
    // The trip only counts once the player is back, and only if they really stood in Minerals Town first. Gojo's
    // greeting (gojo.js) plays first; if the page closed during it, the saved 'return' step finishes it next time.
    if (area === TOWN && stepDone(a, 'visit') && (mark(a, 'return') || stepDone(a, 'return'))) {
      greeting = true;
      (window.LQGojo ? window.LQGojo.greet() : Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
        greeting = false;
        complete(a);
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- Menu page ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const PAGE_CSS = `
.ach-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.ach-card{background:#162033;border:1px solid #34516c;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 14px}
.ach-card.done{border-color:#ffd36b;background:#1d2538}
.ach-ic{font-size:30px;grid-row:span 3;align-self:start}
.ach-card h4{margin:0;font-size:16px;color:#ffd36b}
.ach-card p{margin:0;color:#b8c6dd;font-size:13px}
.ach-steps{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:3px;font-size:13px}
.ach-steps li{color:#9fb0cc}.ach-steps li.ok{color:#8be29b}
.ach-reward{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#0f1726;border:1px dashed #4a5f86;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px}
.ach-reward canvas{image-rendering:pixelated;width:48px;height:100px;flex:none}
.ach-reward canvas.lock{filter:brightness(0) opacity(.55)}
.ach-reward b{display:block;color:#eef3ff;font-size:14px}.ach-reward span{color:#9fb0cc;font-size:12px}
.ach-reward .ach-go{margin-left:auto;background:#f3b94d;color:#1b2630;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.ach-tag{margin-left:auto;color:#ffb4b4;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
`;
  let cssDone = false;

  function presetIndex(name) {
    const ui = window.LQCreatorUI;
    return ui && ui.presets ? ui.presets.findIndex((p) => p.name === name) : -1;
  }

  function renderPage() {
    if (!cssDone) {
      cssDone = true;
      const st = document.createElement('style');
      st.textContent = PAGE_CSS;
      document.head.appendChild(st);
    }
    const total = ACHIEVEMENTS.length;
    const doneCount = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter((a) => isUnlocked(a.id)).length;
    const cards = ACHIEVEMENTS.map((a) => {
      const done = isUnlocked(a.id);
      const list = (a.steps || []).map((s) => ({ ok: stepDone(a, s.id) || done, text: s.text }));
      const steps = list.map((s) => `<li class="${s.ok ? 'ok' : ''}">${s.ok ? '✅' : '⬜'} ${esc(s.text)}</li>`).join('');
      // A counter achievement shows only how many are collected, never where the remaining ones are.
      const c = a.counter ? a.counter() : null;
      const progress = c ? ` (${done ? c.total : c.done}/${c.total})` : '';
      const ch = a.reward && a.reward.character;
      const idx = ch ? presetIndex(ch) : -1;
      const reward = ch
        ? `<div class="ach-reward"><canvas width="24" height="50" data-ach-thumb="${idx}" class="${done ? '' : 'lock'}"></canvas>
            <div><b>${done ? esc(ch) : '🔒 ' + esc(ch)}</b><span>${done ? 'Character unlocked' : 'Complete the achievement to unlock this character'}</span></div>
            ${done ? `<button type="button" class="ach-go" data-l11-action="ach:wear:${idx}">Wear now</button>` : '<span class="ach-tag">Locked</span>'}</div>`
        : '';
      return `<article class="ach-card ${done ? 'done' : ''}"><div class="ach-ic">${done ? '🏆' : a.icon}</div><h4>${esc(a.title)}${progress}</h4><p>${esc(a.desc)}</p>
        <ul class="ach-steps">${steps}</ul>${done ? '' : `<p>💡 ${esc(a.hint)}</p>`}${reward}</article>`;
    }).join('');
    setTimeout(drawThumbs, 0);
    return `<h3>🏆 Achievements</h3><p class="l11-explain">Complete quests to unlock new characters. Completed ${doneCount}/${total}.</p><div class="ach-list">${cards}</div>`;
  }

  function drawThumbs() {
    const sc = getScene();
    const ui = window.LQCreatorUI;
    if (!sc || !ui || !window.LQCharacter) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-ach-thumb]').forEach((cv) => {
      const p = ui.presets[Number(cv.dataset.achThumb)];
      if (!p) return;
      const cx = cv.getContext('2d');
      cx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
      cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      try {
        cx.drawImage(window.LQCharacter.imageFor(sc, ui.presetLook(p), 'down', 0), 0, 0);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('achievement thumbnail failed', e);
      }
    });
  }

  // Called by the Menu for data-l11-action="ach:..." buttons.
  function action(a) {
    if (a.startsWith('wear:')) {
      const i = Number(a.slice(5));
      const ui = window.LQCreatorUI;
      if (ui && ui.applyPreset) ui.applyPreset(i);
      if (window.LQ11_UI) window.LQ11_UI.page('achievements');
    }
  }

  function start() {
    setInterval(tick, 500);
  }

  window.LQAchievements = {
    list: ACHIEVEMENTS,
    isUnlocked,
    hint,
    renderPage,
    action,
    start,
    toast,
    complete: (id) => {
      const a = byId(id);
      if (a) complete(a);
    },
  };
  start();
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Shrine cutscene: plays when the 20th finger is picked up (see fingers.js).
 *
 * 1. Four huge red parallelogram eyes fill a white, speckled screen.
 * 2. The camera pulls back: the eyes shrink up into a blood-red cloudy sky while the white clears, revealing the
 *    domain - a shrine rising out of cyan, rippling water with its reflection.
 * 3. Sukuna is a tiny figure on the shrine roof, dead centre between the eyes, so the domain feels vast around him.
 * 4. The picture holds for a moment, then fades out.
 *
 * It is drawn at 480 x 270 "pixels" and scaled up without smoothing for the pixel-art look.
 * window.LQShrine.play({ freeze }) returns a promise that resolves when the cutscene is over. `freeze` (ms) pins the
 * picture at that moment and never fades; it is only used to take screenshots while tuning the artwork.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const VW = 480;
  const VH = 270;
  const T_EYES = 600; // eyes fill the screen
  const T_PULL = 900; // camera pulls back, white clears
  const T_HOLD = 1100; // the domain, held
  const T_FADE = 1500; // fade out
  const RED = '#ed1c24';
  // Lead-in before the flash: the screen goes dark and a line is typed out letter by letter.
  const LEAD_TEXT = 'King of Curses has arrived';
  const LEAD_FONT = 'Cinzel, "Trajan Pro", "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif';
  const LEAD_FADE = 400; // fade to black
  const LEAD_CHAR = 55; // ms per letter
  const LEAD_HOLD = 800; // pause on the finished line before the cut
  const T_LEAD = LEAD_FADE + LEAD_TEXT.length * LEAD_CHAR + LEAD_HOLD;
  const HORIZON = 150;
  const CX = VW / 2;

  // The four eyes at full-screen size (upper pair large, lower pair smaller); right side is the mirror image.
  const EYES_BIG = [
    [[34, 52], [212, 96], [212, 150], [34, 106]],
    [[62, 176], [200, 176], [186, 236], [48, 236]],
  ];
  const EYES = [...EYES_BIG, ...EYES_BIG.map((e) => e.map(([x, y]) => [VW - x, y]))];
  const BIG_CENTER = [CX, 135];
  const SKY_CENTER = [CX, 50];
  const SKY_SCALE = 0.38;

  const ease = (x) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)), 3);
  const gauss = () => (Math.random() + Math.random() + Math.random() - 1.5) / 0.75;

  function seeded(seed) {
    let s = seed | 0;
    return () => {
      s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  function canvas(w, h) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = w;
    c.height = h;
    return c;
  }

  // ---- static backdrops, painted once ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function paintSky() {
    const c = canvas(VW, HORIZON);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    const rnd = seeded(7);
    const bands = ['#1a0610', '#220813', '#2b0a16', '#340c1a', '#3d0f1e', '#481222', '#531526'];
    const bh = HORIZON / bands.length;
    bands.forEach((col, i) => {
      g.fillStyle = col;
      g.fillRect(0, Math.floor(i * bh), VW, Math.ceil(bh) + 1);
    });
    const shades = ['#2a0b15', '#3a0f1c', '#56142a', '#6c1a2e', '#7d2234'];
    for (let i = 0; i < 130; i++) {
      const x = rnd() * VW;
      const y = rnd() * HORIZON;
      const rx = 18 + rnd() * 52;
      const ry = 5 + rnd() * 15;
      g.fillStyle = shades[Math.floor(rnd() * shades.length)];
      for (const ox of [-VW, 0, VW]) {
        g.beginPath();
        g.ellipse(x + ox, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        g.fill();
      }
    }
    // checkerboard dithering over the clouds
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';
    for (let y = 0; y < HORIZON; y += 2) for (let x = (y / 2) % 2 ? 1 : 0; x < VW; x += 4) g.fillRect(x, y, 1, 1);
    return c;
  }

  function paintWater() {
    const h = VH - HORIZON;
    const c = canvas(VW, h);
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    const rnd = seeded(21);
    const bands = ['#0f5a6a', '#0d4e5d', '#0b4351', '#09394a', '#073040', '#052837', '#04212e'];
    const bh = h / bands.length;
    bands.forEach((col, i) => {
      g.fillStyle = col;
      g.fillRect(0, Math.floor(i * bh), VW, Math.ceil(bh) + 1);
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < 520; i++) {
      const y = rnd() * h;
      const w = 4 + rnd() * 26 * (0.4 + y / h);
      g.fillStyle = rnd() < 0.5 ? 'rgba(53,198,209,0.28)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)';
      g.fillRect(rnd() * VW, y, w, 1);
    }
    return c;
  }

  // ---- the shrine and Sukuna (pixel sprites; feet of the shrine on y = 156) --------------------------------------
  const BASE = 156;
  function shrine(g) {
    const r = (x, y, w, h, col) => {
      g.fillStyle = col;
      g.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
    };
    r(213, 120, 8, BASE - 120, '#c9341a'); // pillars
    r(259, 120, 8, BASE - 120, '#c9341a');
    r(215, 120, 2, BASE - 120, '#e2501f');
    r(261, 120, 2, BASE - 120, '#e2501f');
    r(221, 124, 38, BASE - 124, '#15090e'); // dark body
    r(208, 126, 64, 3, '#8e1f12'); // lower beam
    // roof: dark gable with a red trim on top
    g.fillStyle = '#1d0e16';
    g.beginPath();
    g.moveTo(204, 114);
    g.lineTo(224, 102);
    g.lineTo(256, 102);
    g.lineTo(276, 114);
    g.closePath();
    g.fill();
    r(224, 101, 32, 1, '#7a1a1e');
    r(200, 114, 80, 5, '#e2501f'); // upper beam, ends swept up
    r(200, 114, 80, 1, '#ff8a3a');
    r(200, 110, 6, 5, '#e2501f');
    r(274, 110, 6, 5, '#e2501f');
    // the dark body is a gaping maw with teeth (the shrine itself has no eyes)
    for (let x = 226; x < 254; x += 2) r(x, 146 + ((x / 2) % 2), 1, 2, '#d9d2bd');
  }

  function sukuna(g) {
    const r = (x, y, w, h, col) => {
      g.fillStyle = col;
      g.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
    };
    // soft red glow: a few faint stacked ellipses instead of one hard disc
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,40,40,0.045)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(240, 95, 7 + i * 3, 6 + i * 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      g.fill();
    }
    r(237, 88, 6, 3, '#ea8fa0'); // hair
    r(236, 87, 1, 2, '#ea8fa0');
    r(243, 87, 1, 2, '#ea8fa0');
    r(239, 86, 2, 1, '#ea8fa0');
    r(238, 91, 4, 3, '#f6d2b0'); // face
    r(238, 92, 1, 1, '#c02a2a');
    r(241, 92, 1, 1, '#c02a2a');
    r(236, 94, 8, 8, '#e9e4d6'); // kimono
    r(236, 94, 1, 8, '#233a63');
    r(243, 94, 1, 8, '#233a63');
    r(237, 97, 6, 1, '#cfc9b8'); // folded arms
  }

  // ---- animated parts -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function ripples(g, t) {
    const cy = BASE + 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const r = ((t * 0.028 + i * 17) % 119) + 4;
      const a = 1 - r / 125;
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(150,235,240,${(0.55 * a).toFixed(3)})`;
      const steps = Math.floor(r * 4);
      for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
        const ang = (s / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
        g.fillRect(Math.round(CX + Math.cos(ang) * r * 1.6), Math.round(cy + Math.sin(ang) * r * 0.34), 1, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  function sparkles(g, t) {
    const rnd = seeded(Math.floor(t / 140) + 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
      g.fillStyle = rnd() < 0.5 ? 'rgba(120,230,235,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
      g.fillRect(Math.floor(rnd() * VW), HORIZON + 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * (VH - HORIZON - 4)), 1, 1);
    }
  }

  function ash(g, t) {
    const rnd = seeded(99);
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const x0 = rnd() * VW;
      const y0 = rnd() * HORIZON;
      const sp = 0.012 + rnd() * 0.02;
      const y = (((y0 - t * sp) % HORIZON) + HORIZON) % HORIZON;
      g.fillStyle = rnd() < 0.5 ? 'rgba(255,90,60,0.75)' : 'rgba(255,176,138,0.6)';
      g.fillRect(Math.floor(x0 + Math.sin(t / 700 + i) * 3), Math.floor(y), 1, 1);
    }
  }

  function scene(g, t, sky, water) {
    const off = (t * 0.006) % VW;
    g.drawImage(sky, -off, 0);
    g.drawImage(sky, VW - off, 0);
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,30,44,0.7)';
    g.fillRect(0, HORIZON - 1, VW, 1);
    g.drawImage(water, 0, HORIZON);
    // reflection of the shrine
    g.save();
    g.globalAlpha = 0.32;
    g.translate(0, BASE * 2);
    g.scale(1, -1);
    shrine(g);
    g.restore();
    ripples(g, t);
    sparkles(g, t);
    shrine(g);
    sukuna(g);
    ash(g, t);
  }

  function eyes(g, e, t) {
    const lw = 22 + (7 - 22) * e;
    const flick = e > 0.98 ? 0.93 + 0.07 * Math.sin(t / 90) : 1;
    g.save();
    g.globalAlpha = flick;
    g.lineJoin = 'round';
    for (const eye of EYES) {
      const pts = eye.map(([x, y]) => {
        const sx = SKY_CENTER[0] + (x - BIG_CENTER[0]) * SKY_SCALE;
        const sy = SKY_CENTER[1] + (y - BIG_CENTER[1]) * SKY_SCALE;
        return [x + (sx - x) * e, y + (sy - y) * e];
      });
      g.beginPath();
      g.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) g.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
      g.closePath();
      g.fillStyle = RED;
      g.strokeStyle = RED;
      g.lineWidth = lw;
      g.fill();
      g.stroke();
      g.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      g.lineWidth = 1;
      g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();
  }

  function speckle(g, alpha) {
    if (alpha <= 0.02) return;
    g.globalAlpha = alpha;
    const centers = [[110, 100], [370, 100], [120, 205], [360, 205]];
    for (let i = 0; i < 9000; i++) {
      let x = Math.random() * VW;
      let y = Math.random() * VH;
      if (Math.random() < 0.7) {
        const c = centers[Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
        x = c[0] + gauss() * 70;
        y = c[1] + gauss() * 55;
      }
      g.fillStyle = Math.random() < 0.45 ? RED : '#000';
      g.fillRect(Math.floor(x), Math.floor(y), 1, 1);
    }
    g.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function playSound() {
    try {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      const ac = new AC();
      const t = ac.currentTime;
      const o = ac.createOscillator();
      const g = ac.createGain();
      o.type = 'sine';
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(110, t);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(38, t + 0.9);
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.5, t + 0.03);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 1.4);
      o.connect(g).connect(ac.destination);
      o.start(t);
      o.stop(t + 1.5);
      setTimeout(() => ac.close().catch(() => {}), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      /* sound is optional */
    }
  }

  let playing = false;

  // Start fetching the lead-in font as soon as the script loads, so it is ready by the time the 20th finger is found.
  try {
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.load) document.fonts.load('800 40px Cinzel').catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    /* the serif fallback is used instead */
  }

  function play(opts) {
    const freeze = opts && typeof opts.freeze === 'number' ? opts.freeze : null;
    const leadAt = opts && typeof opts.leadAt === 'number' ? opts.leadAt : null; // screenshots of the lead-in only
    if (playing) return Promise.resolve();
    playing = true;
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      cv.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:9800;pointer-events:none;background:#1a0610';
      document.body.appendChild(cv);
      const W = (cv.width = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth));
      const H = (cv.height = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight));
      const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
      const lo = canvas(VW, VH);
      const g = lo.getContext('2d');
      const sky = paintSky();
      const water = paintWater();
      // wide screens are filled edge to edge; tall ones keep the whole picture and show dark bars
      const scale = W / H >= 1.4 ? Math.max(W / VW, H / VH) : Math.min(W / VW, H / VH);
      const reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      // The dark lead-in: the line is typed in the middle of the screen (split over two lines on narrow screens).
      const drawLead = (el) => {
        cv.style.opacity = String(Math.min(1, el / LEAD_FADE));
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#050207';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.1, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
        vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,12,24,0.28)');
        vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = vg;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        const shown = Math.max(0, Math.min(LEAD_TEXT.length, Math.floor((el - LEAD_FADE) / LEAD_CHAR)));
        const size = Math.max(18, Math.min(W * 0.04, 52));
        ctx.font = `800 ${size}px ${LEAD_FONT}`;
        if ('letterSpacing' in ctx) ctx.letterSpacing = `${(size * 0.1).toFixed(1)}px`; // wide, monumental spacing
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        let lines = [LEAD_TEXT];
        if (ctx.measureText(LEAD_TEXT).width > W * 0.88) {
          const words = LEAD_TEXT.split(' ');
          const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2);
          lines = [words.slice(0, mid).join(' '), words.slice(mid).join(' ')];
        }
        const lh = size * 1.5;
        let left = shown;
        lines.forEach((ln, i) => {
          const part = ln.slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.min(ln.length, left)));
          left -= ln.length + 1;
          const w = ctx.measureText(ln).width;
          const x = (W - w) / 2;
          const y = H / 2 + (i - (lines.length - 1) / 2) * lh;
          ctx.shadowColor = '#ff1c2c';
          ctx.shadowBlur = size * 0.5;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#f4e9e9';
          ctx.fillText(part, x, y);
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
          // blinking caret at the end of what has been typed so far
          if (part.length < ln.length || (i === lines.length - 1 && Math.floor(el / 380) % 2 === 0)) {
            if (part.length > 0 || i === 0) {
              ctx.fillStyle = RED;
              ctx.fillRect(x + ctx.measureText(part).width + 3, y - size * 0.55, Math.max(2, size * 0.06), size * 1.1);
            }
          }
        });
      };
      let soundDone = false;
      const start = performance.now();
      const frame = (now) => {
        const el = now - start;
        if (leadAt !== null || (freeze === null && el < T_LEAD)) {
          drawLead(leadAt !== null ? leadAt : el);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          return;
        }
        if (!soundDone && freeze === null) {
          soundDone = true;
          playSound();
        }
        const t = freeze !== null ? freeze : el - T_LEAD;
        const total = T_EYES + T_PULL + T_HOLD + T_FADE;
        if (freeze === null && t >= total) {
          cv.remove();
          playing = false;
          resolve();
          return;
        }
        const fadeStart = T_EYES + T_PULL + T_HOLD;
        cv.style.opacity = freeze !== null || t < fadeStart ? '1' : String(Math.max(0, 1 - (t - fadeStart) / T_FADE));
        const e = reduce ? 1 : ease((t - T_EYES) / T_PULL);
        // the domain, with the camera easing back from a slight zoom
        g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        g.fillStyle = '#1a0610';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
        g.save();
        const zs = 1.22 - 0.22 * e;
        g.translate(CX, HORIZON);
        g.scale(zs, zs);
        g.translate(-CX, -HORIZON);
        scene(g, t, sky, water);
        g.restore();
        // white screen clears away
        g.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(1 - e).toFixed(3)})`;
        g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
        speckle(g, reduce ? 0 : 1 - e);
        const shake = reduce || freeze !== null ? 0 : Math.max(0, 1 - t / 350) * 3;
        g.save();
        g.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
        eyes(g, e, t);
        g.restore();
        ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1a0610';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        ctx.drawImage(lo, Math.round((W - VW * scale) / 2), Math.round((H - VH * scale) / 2), VW * scale, VH * scale);
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    });
  }

  window.LQShrine = { play };

  // Preview without DevTools: open the game with ?shrine=1 in the address bar and the cutscene plays once after loading.
  if (/[?&]shrine=1\b/.test(location.search)) window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(() => play(), 800));
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Sukuna's 20 fingers: 20 cursed fingers lie at 20 different spots across English Town and Minerals Town. Walking over
 * one picks it up; progress is stored in the normal save (game.ach.fingers), and the 20th finger completes the
 * 'sukuna-fingers' achievement (see achievements.js). Ten fingers lie outdoors on named place tiles and ten lie
 * inside buildings, so they are spread out and always reachable on foot.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const TOWN = 'english-town';
  const MINE = 'mining-town';
  const ACH_ID = 'sukuna-fingers';
  const PICK_RADIUS = 22;

  // Outdoor fingers: x/y are tile coordinates (the same ones used by the areas' `places`).
  // Indoor fingers: `in` is the building name (a key of the interiors); the finger lies on the building's first
  // `guests` tile, which NPCs stand on, so it is always walkable. Only the ground floor is used.
  const FINGERS = [
    { id: 'f01', area: TOWN, x: 25, y: 15, clue: 'In the middle of the park' },
    { id: 'f02', area: TOWN, x: 55, y: 41, clue: 'By the lake' },
    { id: 'f03', area: TOWN, x: 55, y: 22, clue: 'In front of the school' },
    { id: 'f04', area: TOWN, x: 24, y: 61, clue: 'Waiting bench at the English Town station' },
    { id: 'f05', area: TOWN, x: 44, y: 58, clue: 'Cargo area at the English Town station' },
    { id: 'f06', area: TOWN, in: 'Sunny Cafe', clue: 'Inside the Sunny Cafe' },
    { id: 'f07', area: TOWN, in: 'Bank', clue: 'Inside the bank' },
    { id: 'f08', area: TOWN, in: 'Library', clue: 'Inside the library' },
    { id: 'f09', area: TOWN, in: 'Cinema', clue: 'Inside the cinema' },
    { id: 'f10', area: TOWN, in: 'Church', clue: 'Inside the church' },
    { id: 'f11', area: MINE, x: 22, y: 18, clue: 'West side of the mine' },
    { id: 'f12', area: MINE, x: 41, y: 19, clue: 'Ore yard' },
    { id: 'f13', area: MINE, x: 30, y: 28, clue: 'Mining town square' },
    { id: 'f14', area: MINE, x: 38, y: 26, clue: 'In front of the tool shop' },
    { id: 'f15', area: MINE, x: 24, y: 61, clue: 'Waiting bench at the Minerals Town station' },
    { id: 'f16', area: MINE, in: 'Great Mine', clue: 'Inside the Great Mine' },
    { id: 'f17', area: MINE, in: 'Smithy', clue: 'Inside the smithy' },
    { id: 'f18', area: MINE, in: 'Gem Shop', clue: 'Inside the gem shop' },
    { id: 'f19', area: MINE, in: 'Mining Inn', clue: 'Inside the inn' },
    { id: 'f20', area: MINE, in: 'First-Aid Post', clue: 'Inside the first-aid post' },
  ];

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);

  function foundMap(create) {
    const sc = getScene();
    const g = sc && sc.store && sc.store.game;
    if (!g) return {};
    if (!g.ach || typeof g.ach !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return {};
      g.ach = { steps: {}, done: {} };
    }
    if (!g.ach.fingers || typeof g.ach.fingers !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return {};
      g.ach.fingers = {};
    }
    return g.ach.fingers;
  }

  const isFound = (id) => !!foundMap(false)[id];
  const count = () => FINGERS.filter((f) => isFound(f.id)).length;

  let cutsceneBusy = false;

  function collect(sc, f) {
    foundMap(true)[f.id] = Date.now();
    try {
      sc.store.save();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('finger save failed', e);
    }
    const n = count();
    const A = window.LQAchievements;
    if (n >= FINGERS.length) {
      // Unlock only once the cutscene is over; the saved count is enough to finish it later if the page closes now.
      cutsceneBusy = true;
      (window.LQShrine ? window.LQShrine.play() : Promise.resolve()).then(() => {
        cutsceneBusy = false;
        if (A) A.complete(ACH_ID);
      });
    } else if (A) {
      A.toast('👆 Cursed finger', `Collected ${n}/${FINGERS.length} fingers`, 'Keep going!');
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:fingers', { detail: { count: n } }));
  }

  // World position (pixels) and scale of a finger in what the player currently sees, or null when it is not here.
  function spotFor(sc, f) {
    if (f.area !== sc.area.id) return null;
    const ins = sc.inside;
    if (!f.in) return ins ? null : { x: f.x * 32 + 16, y: f.y * 32 + 16, k: 1 };
    if (!ins || ins.floor !== 0 || ins.b.name !== f.in || !ins.objs || !ins.objs[0]) return null;
    const unit = 32 * ins.k;
    const t = ins.spec;
    // objs[0] is the floor image, whose top-left corner is the origin of the interior's tile grid.
    const at = (pt) => ({ x: ins.objs[0].x + (pt[0] + 0.5) * unit, y: ins.objs[0].y + (pt[1] + 0.5) * unit, k: ins.k });
    // Take the first guest tile (or the default one) that no furniture covers, so the finger can always be reached.
    const margin = 12 * ins.k;
    const covered = (p) => (ins.rects || []).some((r) => p.x > r.x - margin && p.x < r.x + r.w + margin && p.y > r.y - margin && p.y < r.y + r.h + margin);
    const cands = [...(t.guests || []), [Math.floor(t.w / 2), Math.max(3, t.h - 4)]].map(at);
    return cands.find((p) => !covered(p)) || cands[0];
  }

  function drawFinger(g, cx, cy, s, time, seed) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.003 + seed);
    const y = cy + Math.sin(time * 0.002 + seed * 1.7) * 1.5 * s;
    // Cursed glow: faint violet halo that builds up towards the centre.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.fillStyle(0xa23bff, 0.035 + pulse * 0.015);
      g.fillCircle(cx, y, (20 - i * 3) * s);
    }
    // The finger: a withered digit with a dark nail and two joint creases.
    g.fillStyle(0x000000, 0.3);
    g.fillEllipse(cx, cy + 9 * s, 12 * s, 4 * s);
    g.fillStyle(0x6e3b55, 1);
    g.fillRoundedRect(cx - 3 * s, y - 8 * s, 6 * s, 15 * s, 3 * s);
    g.fillStyle(0x4a2339, 1);
    g.fillRect(cx - 3 * s, y - 2 * s, 6 * s, s);
    g.fillRect(cx - 3 * s, y + 3 * s, 6 * s, s);
    g.fillStyle(0x1d0f1c, 1);
    g.fillRoundedRect(cx - 2 * s, y - 8 * s, 4 * s, 4 * s, 2 * s);
    g.fillStyle(0xff6b8a, 0.5 + pulse * 0.4);
    g.fillCircle(cx, y + 5 * s, 1.2 * s);
  }

  function draw(sc, time) {
    const st = sc.__lqFingers;
    if (!st) return;
    const g = st.g;
    g.clear();
    if (!sc.area || sc.switching || !sc.player || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) return;
    if (!window.LQAchievements || window.LQAchievements.isUnlocked(ACH_ID)) return;
    const found = foundMap(false);
    const px = sc.player.x;
    const py = sc.player.y;
    FINGERS.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (found[f.id]) return;
      const p = spotFor(sc, f);
      if (!p) return;
      if (Math.hypot(px - p.x, py - p.y) < PICK_RADIUS * p.k) collect(sc, f);
      else drawFinger(g, p.x, p.y, p.k, time, i);
    });
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqFingers) return;
    sc.__lqFingers = { g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(8.8) };
    sc.events.on('update', (time) => draw(sc, time));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqFingers = null;
    });
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqFingers) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('fingers attach failed', e);
      }
    }
  }, 1000);

  // All 20 collected but the achievement is not marked done (page closed during the cutscene): finish it quietly.
  setInterval(() => {
    const A = window.LQAchievements;
    if (A && !cutsceneBusy && getScene() && count() >= FINGERS.length && !A.isUnlocked(ACH_ID)) A.complete(ACH_ID);
  }, 2000);

  // LQFingers.preview() replays the cutscene without changing any progress (handy for tuning it).
  window.LQFingers = {
    list: FINGERS,
    count,
    total: FINGERS.length,
    isFound,
    preview: () => (window.LQShrine ? window.LQShrine.play() : null),
    draw: drawFinger,
    // Where a finger is in what the player sees right now ({x, y, k}) or null; used by Gojo's Six Eyes (gojo.js).
    spot: (id) => {
      const sc = getScene();
      const f = FINGERS.find((x) => x.id === id);
      return sc && sc.area && f ? spotFor(sc, f) : null;
    },
  };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * The Ten Shadows: a guided quest chain that unlocks Megumi.
 *
 *  1. Ask Ms. Green (the librarian) about the Ten Shadows: she tells the legend and the quest starts.
 *  2. Ask the villagers about "the shadows". The ten holders each tell the legend of one shadow beast and a clue to
 *     where its mark is hidden; everybody else points the player on. Only after a holder has told the clue does that
 *     shadow's mark appear in the world (a dark pool with a glowing ring and the beast's icon).
 *  3. Walk over a mark to collect it. The tenth (Mahoraga) only reveals itself once nine are found.
 *  4. Ten shadows complete the 'ten-shadows' achievement (achievements.js), which unlocks Megumi.
 *
 * The quest is also listed in the quest panel (quest 'ten-shadows' in 14-v8-quests-and-minimap.js); its first step
 * reads its text from status() below, so the panel always shows the next clue. Progress is stored in the normal save
 * (game.ach.shadows = { started, told, found }). Chat hook: 10-core-characters-and-scene.js calls onNpcMessage().
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const TOWN = 'english-town';
  const MINE = 'mining-town';
  const ACH_ID = 'ten-shadows';
  const QUEST_ID = 'ten-shadows';
  const PICK_RADIUS = 22;

  // npc = id of the villager who knows this shadow. Outdoor marks use x/y (tile coordinates of the areas' `places`);
  // indoor marks use `in` (building name, first free guest tile of the ground floor, like the fingers).
  const SHADOWS = [
    { id: 'dogs', icon: '🐕', name: 'Divine Dogs', npc: 'police', area: TOWN, x: 19, y: 14,
      clue: 'In the town plaza, where the paths meet.',
      legend: 'The Divine Dogs! Two hounds, one white and one black, who never leave their master. I once saw a black shadow run across the town plaza at dusk. Look for it where the paths meet.' },
    { id: 'nue', icon: '🦉', name: 'Nue', npc: 'teacher', area: TOWN, x: 60, y: 7,
      clue: 'Near the Fire Station, where the alarm sounds like thunder.',
      legend: 'The Nue is a night owl wrapped in lightning. My students say it sleeps near the Fire Station, where the alarm sounds like thunder.' },
    { id: 'serpent', icon: '🐍', name: 'Great Serpent', npc: 'hotelclerk', area: TOWN, in: 'Hotel',
      clue: 'Inside the Hotel, in the quiet lobby.',
      legend: 'The Great Serpent slides through the quietest places. A guest told me something long and dark moved across the floor of our hotel. Look in the lobby.' },
    { id: 'toad', icon: '🐸', name: 'Toad', npc: 'kid', area: TOWN, x: 23, y: 22,
      clue: 'Near the Market, a dark puddle that never dries.',
      legend: 'The Toad! My friends say a giant toad hides near the Market when it rains. It leaves a dark puddle that never dries.' },
    { id: 'elephant', icon: '🐘', name: 'Max Elephant', npc: 'shopkeeper', area: TOWN, in: 'Corner Shop',
      clue: "Inside the Corner Shop (Tom's shop).",
      legend: 'Max Elephant never forgets, and neither do I. A shadow with a long trunk appeared in my shop after closing time. Look inside the Corner Shop.' },
    { id: 'rabbit', icon: '🐇', name: 'Rabbit Escape', npc: 'doctor', area: TOWN, in: 'Hospital',
      clue: 'Inside the Hospital.',
      legend: 'Rabbit Escape is a swarm of little rabbits that run away in every direction. At night I found tiny dark footprints in the hospital. Look inside the Hospital.' },
    { id: 'deer', icon: '🦌', name: 'Round Deer', npc: 'medic', area: MINE, x: 21, y: 37,
      clue: 'Just outside the First-Aid Post.',
      legend: 'The Round Deer heals those who are hurt. On quiet mornings a calm shadow stands just outside the First-Aid Post.' },
    { id: 'ox', icon: '🐂', name: 'Piercing Ox', npc: 'miner', area: MINE, x: 38, y: 18,
      clue: 'On the east side of the mine.',
      legend: 'The Piercing Ox charges straight through rock! On the east side of the mine there is a strange mark where the ground was split.' },
    { id: 'tiger', icon: '🐅', name: 'Tiger Funeral', npc: 'smith', area: MINE, in: 'Tool Shop',
      clue: 'Inside the Tool Shop, near the anvils.',
      legend: 'Tiger Funeral is a tiger made of shadow that sleeps next to cold iron. Look inside the Tool Shop, near the anvils.' },
    { id: 'mahoraga', icon: '⚔️', name: 'Divine General Mahoraga', npc: 'stationmaster', area: MINE, in: 'Rail Station', needs: 9,
      clue: 'Inside the Rail Station, where all the roads meet.',
      legend: 'The last one is Divine General Mahoraga, the strongest of all. It waits where all the roads meet: the Rail Station.' },
  ];

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);
  const A = () => window.LQAchievements;
  const V8 = () => window.LQV8;
  const norm = (s) =>
    String(s || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '')
      .replace(/đ/g, 'd');
  // "ten shadows", "shadow(s)", "shikigami", or the Vietnamese name of the technique.
  const ASKING = /\bshadows?\b|shikigami|thap chung anh/;

  function data(create) {
    const sc = getScene();
    const g = sc && sc.store && sc.store.game;
    if (!g) return null;
    if (!g.ach || typeof g.ach !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return null;
      g.ach = { steps: {}, done: {} };
    }
    if (!g.ach.shadows || typeof g.ach.shadows !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return null;
      g.ach.shadows = { started: 0, told: {}, found: {} };
    }
    const d = g.ach.shadows;
    if (!d.told) d.told = {};
    if (!d.found) d.found = {};
    return d;
  }
  const save = () => {
    const sc = getScene();
    try {
      sc && sc.store && sc.store.save();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('ten shadows save failed', e);
    }
  };

  const isStarted = () => !!(data(false) && data(false).started);
  const isFound = (id) => !!(data(false) && data(false).found[id]);
  const isTold = (id) => !!(data(false) && data(false).told[id]);
  const count = () => SHADOWS.filter((s) => isFound(s.id)).length;
  // Villagers of the other town are not in the scene, so keep their display names here.
  const NAMES = {
    librarian: 'Ms. Green (Librarian)', police: 'Officer Davis (Police)', teacher: 'Ms. Taylor (Teacher)',
    hotelclerk: 'Sofia (Hotel Clerk)', kid: 'Mia (Student)', shopkeeper: 'Tom (Shopkeeper)', doctor: 'Dr. Chen (Doctor)',
    medic: 'Rita (Mine Medic)', miner: 'Ben (Digger)', smith: 'Olga (Blacksmith)', stationmaster: 'Mr. Hale (Station Master)',
  };
  const npcName = (sc, id) => {
    const n = sc && sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((x) => x.def.id === id);
    return n ? n.def.name : NAMES[id] || id;
  };
  const askWho = (sc, s) => npcName(sc, s.npc) + (s.area === MINE ? ' in Minerals Town' : '');

  // The shadow whose clue was told but not collected yet (the oldest one).
  const pending = () => {
    const d = data(false);
    if (!d) return null;
    return (
      SHADOWS.filter((s) => d.told[s.id] && !d.found[s.id]).sort((a, b) => d.told[a.id] - d.told[b.id])[0] || null
    );
  };

  // Text for the quest panel's first step.
  function status() {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (!isStarted()) return 'Ask Ms. Green in the Library about the Ten Shadows. Try typing: "Tell me about the Ten Shadows".';
    const n = count();
    if (n >= SHADOWS.length) return 'All ten shadows found!';
    const p = pending();
    if (p) return `Shadows found: ${n}/10. Next clue: ${p.clue} (${p.name})`;
    const open = SHADOWS.filter((s) => !isTold(s.id) && !(s.needs && n < s.needs)).slice(0, 3).map((s) => askWho(sc, s));
    return `Shadows found: ${n}/10. Ask the villagers about the shadows. Try: ${open.join(', ') || 'anyone you have not asked yet'}.`;
  }

  const refreshQuest = () => {
    try {
      V8() && V8().renderQuest();
    } catch (e) {
      /* the quest panel is not ready */
    }
  };

  function finish() {
    const a = A();
    if (a && !a.isUnlocked(ACH_ID)) a.complete(ACH_ID);
    try {
      const v = V8();
      if (v && v.progressOf(QUEST_ID) === 0) {
        v.select(QUEST_ID);
        v.onEvent('shadows', {});
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('ten shadows quest sync failed', e);
    }
  }

  function collect(sc, s) {
    const d = data(true);
    d.found[s.id] = Date.now();
    save();
    const n = count();
    const a = A();
    if (n >= SHADOWS.length) finish();
    else if (a) a.toast('🌑 Shadow found', `${s.name} · ${n}/${SHADOWS.length}`, n === 9 ? 'One left… Mahoraga is waiting.' : 'Keep asking the villagers.');
    refreshQuest();
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lifequest:shadows', { detail: { count: n } }));
  }

  // ---- chat hook: what villagers say when asked about the shadows -----------------------------------------------
  function onNpcMessage(npcId, text, areaId) {
    const m = norm(text);
    if (!ASKING.test(m)) return [];
    const sc = getScene();
    const d = data(true);
    if (!d) return [];
    const who = npcName(sc, npcId);
    const say = (t) => `📜 ${who}: ${t}`;
    const n = count();
    const v8 = V8();

    if (npcId === 'librarian') {
      if (!d.started) {
        d.started = Date.now();
        save();
        try {
          v8 && v8.select(QUEST_ID);
        } catch (e) {}
        refreshQuest();
        const a = A();
        if (a) a.toast('📜 New quest', 'The Ten Shadows', 'Ask the villagers about the shadows. See Quests (V) for clues.');
        return [
          say('Ah, the Ten Shadows! An old legend says a sorcerer could call ten shadow beasts from his own shadow.'),
          say('When he vanished, the shadows left their marks across English Town and Minerals Town.'),
          say('Ask the villagers about the shadows: each one knows a story and a clue. Find all ten marks, and tell me when you are done.'),
        ];
      }
      if (n >= SHADOWS.length) {
        try {
          v8 && v8.select(QUEST_ID);
        } catch (e) {}
        return [say('You found all ten shadows! The power of the Ten Shadows answers you now. Well done!')];
      }
      return [say(`You have found ${n} of the ten shadows. ${pending() ? 'Remember the clue: ' + pending().clue : 'Ask the villagers about the shadows to learn the next clue.'}`)];
    }

    if (!d.started) return [say('Shadows? I only know old stories. Ms. Green in the Library knows the whole legend. Try asking her.')];

    const s = SHADOWS.find((x) => x.npc === npcId);
    if (!s) {
      const open = SHADOWS.filter((x) => !d.told[x.id] && !(x.needs && n < x.needs));
      const here = open.find((x) => x.area === areaId) || open[0];
      return [say(here ? `I do not know much about the shadows. Try asking ${askWho(sc, here)}.` : 'I do not know much about the shadows. Check the quest panel for your next clue.')];
    }
    if (d.found[s.id]) return [say(`You already found the ${s.name}. Well done!`)];
    if (d.told[s.id]) return [say(`I already told you about the ${s.name}. Remember: ${s.clue}`)];
    if (s.needs && n < s.needs) return [say(`Come back when you have found the other ${s.needs} shadows. Ask the villagers about them first.`)];
    d.told[s.id] = Date.now();
    save();
    refreshQuest();
    const a = A();
    if (a) a.toast('📜 New clue', s.name, s.clue);
    return [say(s.legend), `🌑 Clue: ${s.clue}`];
  }

  // ---- marks in the world -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // World position (pixels) and scale of a mark in what the player currently sees, or null when it is not here.
  function spotFor(sc, s) {
    if (s.area !== sc.area.id) return null;
    const ins = sc.inside;
    if (!s.in) return ins ? null : { x: s.x * 32 + 16, y: s.y * 32 + 16, k: 1 };
    if (!ins || ins.floor !== 0 || ins.b.name !== s.in || !ins.objs || !ins.objs[0]) return null;
    const unit = 32 * ins.k;
    const t = ins.spec;
    const at = (pt) => ({ x: ins.objs[0].x + (pt[0] + 0.5) * unit, y: ins.objs[0].y + (pt[1] + 0.5) * unit, k: ins.k });
    const margin = 12 * ins.k;
    const covered = (p) => (ins.rects || []).some((r) => p.x > r.x - margin && p.x < r.x + r.w + margin && p.y > r.y - margin && p.y < r.y + r.h + margin);
    // Try the guest tiles from the end so a mark does not share a tile with a finger (those use the first free one).
    const cands = [...(t.guests || []), [Math.floor(t.w / 2) + 1, Math.max(3, t.h - 4)]].map(at).reverse();
    return cands.find((p) => !covered(p)) || cands[0];
  }

  function drawMark(g, cx, cy, s, time, seed) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.003 + seed);
    // Blue-violet glow that builds up towards the centre.
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      g.fillStyle(i % 2 ? 0x5a6cff : 0x8a4bff, 0.03 + pulse * 0.014);
      g.fillCircle(cx, cy, (22 - i * 3) * s);
    }
    // A dark pool on the ground with a slowly spreading ring.
    const ring = (time * 0.0008 + seed * 0.37) % 1;
    g.fillStyle(0x6a5cff, 0.2 * (1 - ring));
    g.fillEllipse(cx, cy + 5 * s, (14 + 16 * ring) * s, (5 + 6 * ring) * s);
    g.fillStyle(0x07070f, 0.85);
    g.fillEllipse(cx, cy + 5 * s, 18 * s, 7 * s);
    g.fillStyle(0x15152a, 0.9);
    g.fillEllipse(cx - 2 * s, cy + 4 * s, 9 * s, 3 * s);
  }

  function draw(sc, time) {
    const st = sc.__lqTenShadows;
    if (!st) return;
    st.g.clear();
    st.texts.forEach((t) => t.setVisible(false));
    if (!sc.area || sc.switching || !sc.player || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) return;
    const d = data(false);
    if (!d || !d.started) return;
    const px = sc.player.x;
    const py = sc.player.y;
    SHADOWS.forEach((s, i) => {
      // A mark exists in the world only after its villager told the clue, and until it is collected.
      if (!d.told[s.id] || d.found[s.id]) return;
      const p = spotFor(sc, s);
      if (!p) return;
      if (Math.hypot(px - p.x, py - p.y) < PICK_RADIUS * p.k) {
        collect(sc, s);
        return;
      }
      drawMark(st.g, p.x, p.y, p.k, time, i);
      const t = st.texts[i];
      t.setPosition(p.x, p.y - 4 * p.k + Math.sin(time * 0.002 + i) * 1.5 * p.k).setScale(p.k).setVisible(true);
    });
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqTenShadows) return;
    sc.__lqTenShadows = {
      g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(8.8),
      texts: SHADOWS.map((s) => sc.add.text(0, 0, s.icon, { fontSize: '16px' }).setOrigin(0.5, 1).setDepth(8.9).setVisible(false)),
    };
    sc.events.on('update', (time) => draw(sc, time));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqTenShadows = null;
    });
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    const sc = getScene();
    if (sc && sc.add && sc.events && sc.player && !sc.__lqTenShadows) {
      try {
        attach(sc);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('ten shadows attach failed', e);
      }
    }
  }, 1000);

  // All ten found but the achievement is not marked done (for example an older save): finish it quietly.
  setInterval(() => {
    const a = A();
    if (a && getScene() && count() >= SHADOWS.length && !a.isUnlocked(ACH_ID)) finish();
  }, 2000);

  window.LQTenShadows = {
    list: SHADOWS,
    total: SHADOWS.length,
    count,
    isFound,
    isTold,
    isStarted,
    status,
    onNpcMessage,
    drawMark,
    // Where a mark is in what the player sees right now ({x, y, k}) or null; for testing.
    spot: (id) => {
      const sc = getScene();
      const s = SHADOWS.find((x) => x.id === id);
      return sc && s ? spotFor(sc, s) : null;
    },
    // Handy while testing: LQTenShadows.reset() starts over (does not lock Megumi again).
    reset() {
      const d = data(false);
      if (d) {
        d.started = 0;
        d.told = {};
        d.found = {};
        save();
        refreshQuest();
      }
    },
  };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * The Old Map: the way into Chapter 2 ("70 Years Ago"). Script: Chapter2.md (scenario A, with the helmet from C).
 *
 *  0. Opens after the quest "🌱 First Day in Town" (or for old saves that skipped the tutorial). A toast says Ms. Green
 *     found something strange in the Library.
 *  1. Ask Ms. Green about the old map (map / old / history / strange / find…). She shows an English Town map from
 *     seventy years ago and asks the player to find three old things that are still in town today.
 *  2. Find the three relics: a wall stone with the Oriaris crest, the brass plate of the old village well under the
 *     park fountain, and an old soldier's helmet in Mr. Brown's House. Walk onto a relic to find it.
 *  3. Tell Ms. Green what you found IN THE PAST TENSE ("I found an old stone."). Each relic needs its own sentence
 *     with the relic word and a past verb. Present tense gets a gentle hint (find → found).
 *  4. When all three are told, she starts the story. After the chat closes, the world turns grey and the Chapter 2
 *     prelude plays over the old map (drawn from the real English Town data, without the modern buildings).
 *
 * Quest panel: quest 'old-map' in 14-v8-quests-and-minimap.js (steps 'oldmap' and 'oldmap-tell', texts from
 * status()/tellStatus() here). Progress: game.ach.oldmap = { hinted, started, found, told, storyAt, seen }.
 * Chat hook: 10-core-characters-and-scene.js calls onNpcMessage().
 * Testing: LQOldMap.status(), LQOldMap.preview() (or index.html?oldmap=1), LQOldMap.reset().
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const TOWN = 'english-town';
  const QUEST_ID = 'old-map';
  const PICK_RADIUS = 22;

  // Outdoor relics use tile x/y of English Town; the indoor one uses `in` (ground floor, first free guest tile).
  const RELICS = [
    {
      id: 'stone',
      name: 'Wall stone',
      icon: '🪨',
      area: TOWN,
      x: 42,
      y: 16,
      words: /\b(stones?|rocks?|walls?|crest)\b/,
      clue: 'On the east side of town, by the trees near the road to the school.',
      plate: 'This stone was part of the Wall of Oriaris.',
      plateVi: 'Hòn đá này từng là một phần của Tường Oriaris.',
      example: 'I found an old stone.',
    },
    {
      id: 'well',
      name: 'Village well',
      icon: '🪣',
      area: TOWN,
      x: 28,
      y: 16,
      // "well" is also a filler word ("Well, …"), so it only counts after "the/old/a/village".
      words: /\b(the|an?|old|village) well\b|\b(fountain|plate|water)\b/,
      clue: 'In the park, next to the fountain.',
      plate: 'Here was the village well. Every family came here for water.',
      plateVi: 'Đây từng là giếng làng. Mọi gia đình đều đến đây lấy nước.',
      example: 'I saw the old well.',
    },
    {
      id: 'helmet',
      name: 'Old helmet',
      icon: '⛑️',
      area: TOWN,
      in: "Mr. Brown's House",
      words: /\b(helmets?|hat|soldier)\b/,
      clue: "Inside Mr. Brown's House (the mayor's home).",
      plate: 'This helmet belonged to a young soldier of the village.',
      plateVi: 'Chiếc mũ sắt này từng thuộc về một người lính trẻ của làng.',
      example: 'I found an old helmet.',
    },
  ];

  // Regular past (-ed, five letters or more so "need"/"red" do not count) and the irregular verbs players use most.
  const PAST =
    /\b(was|were|found|saw|went|came|had|did|got|took|made|felt|heard|thought|knew|left|ran|became|told|said|wore|stood|sat|gave|met|read|brought|built|lost|kept|began|fell|ate|drank|wrote)\b|\b[a-z]{3,}ed\b/;
  const PRESENT = /\b(find|see|is|are|go|have|look|touch|visit|discover)\b/;
  const START = /\b(maps?|old|history|strange|past|something|find|found|discover\w*)\b/;
  const BROWN = /\b(helmets?|maps?|old|father|dad|flag|war|soldier|history)\b/;

  const getScene = () => (typeof window.__lifequestGetScene === 'function' ? window.__lifequestGetScene() : null);
  const A = () => window.LQAchievements;
  const V8 = () => window.LQV8;
  const norm = (s) =>
    String(s || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '')
      .replace(/đ/g, 'd');
  const toast = (title, sub, hint) => {
    try {
      A() && A().toast && A().toast(title, sub, hint);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  function game() {
    const sc = getScene();
    return (sc && sc.store && sc.store.game) || null;
  }
  function data(create) {
    const g = game();
    if (!g) return null;
    if (!g.ach || typeof g.ach !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return null;
      g.ach = { steps: {}, done: {} };
    }
    if (!g.ach.oldmap || typeof g.ach.oldmap !== 'object') {
      if (!create) return null;
      g.ach.oldmap = { hinted: 0, started: 0, found: {}, told: {}, storyAt: 0, seen: 0 };
    }
    const d = g.ach.oldmap;
    if (!d.found) d.found = {};
    if (!d.told) d.told = {};
    return d;
  }
  const save = () => {
    const sc = getScene();
    try {
      sc && sc.store && sc.store.save();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('old map save failed', e);
    }
  };

  // Open after the first quest; saves from before the tutorial existed (game.tut.done === 'old') are let in too.
  function isOpen() {
    const g = game();
    if (!g) return false;
    if (g.tut && g.tut.done === 'old') return true;
    try {
      return !!(V8() && V8().isDone && V8().isDone('first-day'));
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  const isStarted = () => !!(data(false) && data(false).started);
  const isFound = (id) => !!(data(false) && data(false).found[id]);
  const isTold = (id) => !!(data(false) && data(false).told[id]);
  const foundCount = () => RELICS.filter((r) => isFound(r.id)).length;
  const toldCount = () => RELICS.filter((r) => isTold(r.id)).length;
  const allFound = () => foundCount() >= RELICS.length;
  const allTold = () => toldCount() >= RELICS.length;

  // ---- quest panel texts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function status() {
    if (!isOpen()) return 'Finish "🌱 First Day in Town" first. Then visit Ms. Green in the Library.';
    if (!isStarted()) return 'Ask Ms. Green in the Library about the old map. Try: "Did you find something old?"';
    if (allFound()) return 'You found all three old things!';
    const next = RELICS.filter((r) => !isFound(r.id));
    return `Old things found: ${foundCount()}/3. ${next.map((r) => r.icon + ' ' + r.clue).join(' ')}`;
  }
  function tellStatus() {
    const next = RELICS.find((r) => isFound(r.id) && !isTold(r.id));
    return (
      `Tell Ms. Green what you found, in the past tense (${toldCount()}/3).` +
      (next ? ` Try: "${next.example}"` : ' Find the old things first.')
    );
  }

  const refreshQuest = () => {
    try {
      V8() && V8().renderQuest();
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  // Keep the quest panel in step with what happened here (also repairs saves where the panel fell behind).
  function syncQuest() {
    const v = V8();
    if (!v || !v.progressOf) return;
    try {
      if (allFound() && v.progressOf(QUEST_ID) === 0) {
        v.select(QUEST_ID);
        v.onEvent('oldmap', {});
      }
      if (allTold() && v.progressOf(QUEST_ID) === 1) {
        v.select(QUEST_ID);
        v.onEvent('oldmap-tell', {});
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('old map quest sync failed', e);
    }
  }

  // ---- chat hook ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function onNpcMessage(npcId, text, areaId) {
    if (npcId !== 'librarian' && npcId !== 'mayor') return [];
    const m = norm(text);
    const sc = getScene();
    const who = (id) => {
      const n = sc && sc.npcs && sc.npcs.find((x) => x.def.id === id);
      return n ? n.def.name : id === 'mayor' ? 'Mr. Brown (Mayor)' : 'Ms. Green (Librarian)';
    };
    const say = (id, t) => `📜 ${who(id)}: ${t}`;

    if (npcId === 'mayor') {
      // After Chapter 2 (past.js): he tells the end of his father's story.
      if (window.LQPast && window.LQPast.isDone && window.LQPast.isDone() && /\b(father|dad|flag|glory|war|helmet|soldier|story|village|oriaris)\b/.test(m))
        return [
          say('mayor', 'You saw it? Yes. My father ran home with the victory flag on March 29th.'),
          say('mayor', 'He was only seventeen. Every year on the Day of Glory, we remember him and everyone at the wall.'),
          say('mayor', 'Thank you for listening to their story.'),
        ];
      if (!isStarted() || !BROWN.test(m)) return [];
      if (!isFound('helmet'))
        return [say('mayor', 'An old helmet? Yes, there is one in my house. It was my father’s. You can go in and look.')];
      return [
        say('mayor', 'That helmet? My father wore it when he was young. One day I will tell you the whole story.'),
        say('mayor', 'Ms. Green knows the history better than me. Tell her what you found.'),
      ];
    }

    // Ms. Green
    if (!isOpen()) {
      if (/\b(maps?|history)\b/.test(m)) return [say('librarian', 'Old maps? I am still cleaning the old shelves. Come back another day, dear.')];
      return [];
    }
    const d = data(true);
    if (!d.started) {
      if (!START.test(m)) return [];
      d.started = Date.now();
      d.hinted = d.hinted || Date.now();
      save();
      try {
        V8() && V8().select(QUEST_ID);
      } catch (e) {}
      refreshQuest();
      toast('📜 New quest', 'The Old Map', 'Find three old things in town. See Quests (V) for clues.');
      return [
        say('librarian', 'Oh, you came at the right time! I was cleaning the old shelves, and I found this.'),
        say('librarian', 'It is a map of English Town. But look: there is no school, no cinema, no station.'),
        say('librarian', 'There was a big stone wall around the village, and rice fields everywhere. This map was made seventy years ago.'),
        say('librarian', 'Some old things are still here, in our town today. Can you find three of them?'),
        '🗺️ Clue: ' + RELICS.map((r) => r.icon + ' ' + r.clue).join(' '),
      ];
    }
    if (d.storyAt) {
      if (d.seen && /\b(back|village|past|again|return|take me)\b/.test(m)) {
        d.goPast = Date.now();
        save();
        return [say('librarian', 'You want to see the old village again? Close your eyes, dear…'), '🗺️ (Close the chat to go back seventy years.)'];
      }
      if (START.test(m) || /\b(story|again)\b/.test(m))
        return [say('librarian', d.seen ? 'I put the old map on the wall. Look at it any time you want.' : 'Sit down and listen, dear. The story starts when we finish talking.')];
      return [];
    }

    // Telling: every sentence that names a found relic in the past tense counts once.
    const named = RELICS.filter((r) => isFound(r.id) && !isTold(r.id) && r.words.test(m));
    if (named.length) {
      if (!PAST.test(m)) {
        const verb = (m.match(PRESENT) || [])[1];
        const hint = verb ? ` Say it in the past: "${verb}" → "${pastOf(verb)}".` : '';
        return [say('librarian', `Almost! Tell me about it in the past, dear.${hint} For example: "${named[0].example}"`)];
      }
      named.forEach((r) => (d.told[r.id] = Date.now()));
      save();
      refreshQuest();
      const lines = named.map((r) => say('librarian', reaction(r.id)));
      if (allTold()) {
        d.storyAt = Date.now();
        save();
        lines.push(
          say('librarian', 'You found all three! The wall, the well, and the helmet.'),
          say('librarian', 'Now I can tell you their story. Sit down, dear. Look at the map, and listen…'),
          '🗺️ (Close the chat to hear the story.)',
        );
        syncQuest();
      } else {
        const left = RELICS.filter((r) => !isTold(r.id));
        lines.push(say('librarian', `What else did you find? (${toldCount()}/3)`));
        if (left.some((r) => !isFound(r.id))) lines.push('🗺️ Clue: ' + left.filter((r) => !isFound(r.id)).map((r) => r.icon + ' ' + r.clue).join(' '));
      }
      return lines;
    }
    // Named a relic that is not found yet.
    const early = RELICS.find((r) => !isFound(r.id) && r.words.test(m));
    if (early) return [say('librarian', `Did you find it? Look again: ${early.clue}`)];
    if (START.test(m)) {
      if (!allFound()) return [say('librarian', `You found ${foundCount()} of the three old things. ` + RELICS.filter((r) => !isFound(r.id)).map((r) => r.icon + ' ' + r.clue).join(' '))];
      return [say('librarian', `Tell me what you found, in the past tense. For example: "${RELICS.find((r) => !isTold(r.id)).example}"`)];
    }
    return [];
  }
  const PAST_OF = { find: 'found', see: 'saw', is: 'was', are: 'were', go: 'went', have: 'had', look: 'looked', touch: 'touched', visit: 'visited', discover: 'discovered' };
  const pastOf = (v) => PAST_OF[v] || v + 'ed';
  function reaction(id) {
    if (id === 'stone') return 'Yes! That stone was part of the Wall of Oriaris. The people built it with their own hands.';
    if (id === 'well') return 'The old well! Every family came there for water. Now children play by the fountain.';
    return 'The helmet! It belonged to Mr. Brown’s father. He was a young soldier then.';
  }

  // ---- relics in the world ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function spotFor(sc, r) {
    if (r.area !== sc.area.id) return null;
    const ins = sc.inside;
    if (!r.in) return ins ? null : { x: r.x * 32 + 16, y: r.y * 32 + 16, k: 1 };
    if (!ins || ins.floor !== 0 || ins.b.name !== r.in || !ins.objs || !ins.objs[0]) return null;
    const unit = 32 * ins.k;
    const t = ins.spec;
    const at = (pt) => ({ x: ins.objs[0].x + (pt[0] + 0.5) * unit, y: ins.objs[0].y + (pt[1] + 0.5) * unit, k: ins.k });
    const margin = 12 * ins.k;
    const covered = (p) => (ins.rects || []).some((q) => p.x > q.x - margin && p.x < q.x + q.w + margin && p.y > q.y - margin && p.y < q.y + q.h + margin);
    const cands = [...(t.guests || []), [Math.floor(t.w / 2) + 1, Math.max(3, t.h - 4)]].map(at);
    return cands.find((p) => !covered(p)) || cands[0];
  }

  // Gold crest of the Oriaris family: a shield with a tower. Keep this shape; it comes back in Chapter 2.
  function drawCrest(g, cx, cy, s) {
    g.fillStyle(0xd9a93a, 1);
    g.fillRect(cx - 4 * s, cy - 4 * s, 8 * s, 5 * s);
    g.fillTriangle(cx - 4 * s, cy + 1 * s, cx + 4 * s, cy + 1 * s, cx, cy + 5 * s);
    g.fillStyle(0x6b4a12, 1);
    g.fillRect(cx - 1.5 * s, cy - 2.5 * s, 3 * s, 5 * s);
    g.fillRect(cx - 2.5 * s, cy - 3 * s, 1 * s, 1 * s);
    g.fillRect(cx - 0.5 * s, cy - 3 * s, 1 * s, 1 * s);
    g.fillRect(cx + 1.5 * s, cy - 3 * s, 1 * s, 1 * s);
  }
  function drawRelic(g, cx, cy, s, r, time, seed) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(time * 0.003 + seed);
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      g.fillStyle(0xffe2a0, 0.03 + pulse * 0.02);
      g.fillCircle(cx, cy, (20 - i * 3) * s);
    }
    g.fillStyle(0x000000, 0.25);
    g.fillEllipse(cx, cy + 9 * s, 20 * s, 6 * s);
    if (r.id === 'stone') {
      g.fillStyle(0x7d7a74, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 10 * s, cy - 6 * s, 20 * s, 15 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x99958d, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 10 * s, cy - 6 * s, 20 * s, 3 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x5f5c57, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 10 * s, cy + 2 * s, 7 * s, 1 * s);
      g.fillRect(cx + 4 * s, cy + 5 * s, 6 * s, 1 * s);
      drawCrest(g, cx, cy + 1 * s, s);
    } else if (r.id === 'well') {
      g.fillStyle(0x6e4a1e, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 7 * s, cy - 5 * s, 14 * s, 11 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0xc99a4a, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 6 * s, cy - 4 * s, 12 * s, 9 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x8a6526, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 4 * s, cy - 2 * s, 8 * s, 1 * s);
      g.fillRect(cx - 4 * s, cy, 8 * s, 1 * s);
      g.fillRect(cx - 4 * s, cy + 2 * s, 5 * s, 1 * s);
    } else {
      g.fillStyle(0x4d5248, 1);
      g.fillEllipse(cx, cy + 4 * s, 22 * s, 6 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x6c7362, 1);
      g.fillCircle(cx, cy + 2 * s, 8 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x4d5248, 1);
      g.fillRect(cx - 8 * s, cy + 2 * s, 16 * s, 3 * s);
      g.fillStyle(0x8e9682, 1);
      g.fillCircle(cx - 3 * s, cy - 2 * s, 2 * s);
    }
  }

  function find(sc, r) {
    const d = data(true);
    d.found[r.id] = Date.now();
    save();
    const n = foundCount();
    toast(r.icon + ' ' + r.name, `“${r.plate}”`, `${r.plateVi} · ${n}/3`);
    if (n >= RELICS.length) {
      setTimeout(() => toast('🗺️ All three found!', 'Go back to Ms. Green.', 'Tell her what you found, in the past tense: "I found…", "I saw…"'), 4200);
      syncQuest();
    }
    refreshQuest();
  }

  function draw(sc, time) {
    const st = sc.__lqOldMap;
    if (!st) return;
    st.g.clear();
    if (!sc.area || sc.switching || !sc.player || !sc.store || !sc.store.game) return;
    const d = data(false);
    if (!d || !d.started) return;
    RELICS.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (d.found[r.id]) return;
      const p = spotFor(sc, r);
      if (!p) return;
      if (Math.hypot(sc.player.x - p.x, sc.player.y - p.y) < PICK_RADIUS * p.k) {
        find(sc, r);
        return;
      }
      drawRelic(st.g, p.x, p.y, p.k, r, time, i);
    });
  }

  function attach(sc) {
    if (sc.__lqOldMap) return;
    sc.__lqOldMap = { g: sc.add.graphics().setDepth(8.7) };
    sc.events.on('update', (time) => draw(sc, time));
    sc.events.once('shutdown', () => {
      sc.__lqOldMap = null;
    });
  }

  // ---- Chapter 2 prelude --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const CSS = `
#lq-oldmap{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10050;background:#000;opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s;font-family:system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
#lq-oldmap.on{opacity:1}
#lq-oldmap canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#lq-oldmap .chap{position:absolute;left:50%;top:30%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);text-align:center;color:#eee;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000c;opacity:0;animation:lqOmChap 3s ease forwards;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
#lq-oldmap .chap small{display:block;font:700 13px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.35em;color:#d6d0c4;text-transform:uppercase}
#lq-oldmap .chap b{display:block;font:800 clamp(30px,6vw,52px)/1.1 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;margin:6px 0}
#lq-oldmap .chap span{font:600 14px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#bdbdbd}
@keyframes lqOmChap{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-40%)}18%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
#lq-oldmap .skip{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:#0009;color:#fff;border:1px solid #ffffff55;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px;font:700 13px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
#lq-oldmap .box{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(760px,calc(100vw - 32px));box-sizing:border-box;background:#1c1c1cf0;border:2px solid #b9b2a4;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 18px 10px;color:#f2f2f2;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
#lq-oldmap .box.show{opacity:1}
#lq-oldmap .who{font:800 12px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#d6d0c4;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:4px}
#lq-oldmap .en{margin:0;font:600 clamp(16px,2.4vw,20px)/1.4 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;min-height:1.4em}
#lq-oldmap .vi{margin:6px 0 0;font:15px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#b8b8b8}
#lq-oldmap .foot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:8px}
#lq-oldmap .next{background:#d6d0c4;color:#1c1c1c;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 14px;font:800 14px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
`;
  // Ms. Green tells the start of the story in the past tense (the topic of Chapter 2).
  const STORY = [
    { en: 'Seventy years ago, English Town was a small village.', vi: 'Bảy mươi năm trước, English Town chỉ là một ngôi làng nhỏ.' },
    { en: 'There were only a few houses, some rice fields and a long stone wall.', vi: 'Làng chỉ có vài ngôi nhà, mấy thửa ruộng lúa và một bức tường đá dài.' },
    { en: 'The Oriaris family ruled the village. Their leader was Lord Gusest.', vi: 'Gia tộc Oriaris cai quản ngôi làng. Người đứng đầu là Lãnh chúa Gusest.' },
    { en: 'One day, warriors from North Ire came. The villagers built the wall to protect their homes.', vi: 'Một ngày nọ, chiến binh Bắc Ire kéo đến. Dân làng dựng bức tường để bảo vệ nhà cửa.' },
    { en: 'And a young soldier wore that helmet…', vi: 'Và một người lính trẻ đã đội chiếc mũ sắt ấy…' },
    { en: 'Close your eyes, dear… and you will see it.', vi: 'Nhắm mắt lại nào cháu… rồi cháu sẽ thấy.', end: true },
  ];
  const OLD_HOUSES = ["Lily's House", "Ms. Green's House", "Mr. Brown's House", "Hero's Home", "Tom's House", "Mia's House"];
  const WALL = { x: 1, y: 1, w: 42, h: 30 };

  // The old village drawn from the real English Town data: no modern buildings, a wall around the centre,
  // rice fields where the school and the station are now, the well where the fountain is.
  function drawOldMap(cv, area, t) {
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const W = (cv.width = cv.clientWidth * (window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    const H = (cv.height = cv.clientHeight * (window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const aw = (area && area.w) || 64;
    const ah = 48;
    const zoom = 1 + 0.04 * Math.min(1, t / 20000);
    const k = Math.min(W / (aw + 4), H / (ah + 4)) * zoom;
    const ox = (W - aw * k) / 2;
    const oy = (H - ah * k) / 2.4;
    const R = (x, y, w, h) => [ox + x * k, oy + y * k, w * k, h * k];
    // Paper
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c9c4b8';
    ctx.fillRect(...R(-1, -1, aw + 2, ah + 2));
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6f6a60';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, k * 0.25);
    ctx.strokeRect(...R(-1, -1, aw + 2, ah + 2));
    // Rice fields: rows of short lines
    const field = (x, y, w, h) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#b3ae9f';
      ctx.fillRect(...R(x, y, w, h));
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8f8a7c';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, k * 0.08);
      for (let yy = y + 0.6; yy < y + h; yy += 1.1)
        for (let xx = x + 0.4; xx < x + w - 0.6; xx += 1.3) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(ox + xx * k, oy + yy * k);
          ctx.lineTo(ox + (xx + 0.6) * k, oy + yy * k);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
    };
    field(47, 2, 15, 12);
    field(47, 16, 15, 16);
    field(2, 34, 18, 12);
    field(22, 34, 22, 12);
    // Pond (now the lake)
    const lake = { x: 51, y: 36, w: 8, h: 4 };
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8d9192';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(ox + (lake.x + lake.w / 2) * k, oy + (lake.y + lake.h / 2) * k, (lake.w / 2) * k, (lake.h / 2) * k, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Dirt paths where the main roads are now
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b9b2a2';
    ctx.fillRect(...R(17, 1, 3, 30));
    ctx.fillRect(...R(1, 10.5, 41, 2));
    // The wall
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4b4842';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, k * 0.6);
    ctx.setLineDash([k * 0.9, k * 0.25]);
    ctx.strokeRect(...R(WALL.x, WALL.y, WALL.w, WALL.h));
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // Houses (the six family houses) and the Oriaris hall where the Town Hall is now
    const buildings = (area && area.buildings) || [];
    const roof = (b, big) => {
      const [x, y, w, h] = R(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      ctx.fillStyle = big ? '#5e5a52' : '#77726a';
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + h * 0.35, w, h * 0.65);
      ctx.fillStyle = big ? '#3f3c37' : '#56524b';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - k * 0.2, y + h * 0.4);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w / 2, y);
      ctx.lineTo(x + w + k * 0.2, y + h * 0.4);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    };
    buildings.filter((b) => OLD_HOUSES.includes(b.name)).forEach((b) => roof(b));
    const hall = buildings.find((b) => b.name === 'Town Hall');
    if (hall) roof(hall, true);
    // The well (now the fountain)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4b4842';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ox + 27 * k, oy + 15 * k, k * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2826';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ox + 27 * k, oy + 15 * k, k * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Labels
    const label = (txt, x, y, size) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3731';
      ctx.font = `italic ${Math.max(10, k * size)}px Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(txt, ox + x * k, oy + y * k);
    };
    label('Village of Oriaris', aw / 2, -2.2, 1.6);
    if (hall) label('Oriaris Hall', hall.x + hall.w / 2, hall.y + hall.h + 1.4, 0.9);
    label('the well', 27, 17.6, 0.85);
    label('Wall of Oriaris', 21.5, 32.4, 0.95);
    label('rice fields', 54.5, 9, 0.95);
    label('rice fields', 22, 41, 0.95);
    label('pond', 55, 43, 0.85);
    // Old paper: soft vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  let playing = null;
  function playPrelude() {
    if (playing) return playing;
    if (!document.getElementById('lq-oldmap-css')) {
      const st = document.createElement('style');
      st.id = 'lq-oldmap-css';
      st.textContent = CSS;
      document.head.appendChild(st);
    }
    playing = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const sc = getScene();
      const canvas = sc && sc.game && sc.game.canvas;
      // 1. The world loses its colour.
      if (canvas) {
        canvas.style.transition = 'filter 1.8s ease';
        canvas.style.filter = 'grayscale(1) brightness(.85)';
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        let paused = false;
        try {
          if (sc && sc.scene && sc.scene.isActive && sc.scene.isActive()) {
            sc.scene.pause();
            paused = true;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        const root = document.createElement('div');
        root.id = 'lq-oldmap';
        root.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
        root.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Chapter 2 prelude');
        root.innerHTML =
          '<canvas></canvas>' +
          '<div class="chap"><small>Chapter 2</small><b>70 Years Ago</b><span>Chương 2 · 70 năm trước</span></div>' +
          '<button class="skip" type="button">Skip ⏭</button>' +
          '<div class="box"><div class="who">Ms. Green</div><p class="en"></p><p class="vi"></p><div class="foot"><button class="next" type="button">Next ▶</button></div></div>';
